5056.name: A Nomad Camp
5056.description:
This small group of desert nomads has stopped for the day to rest and
refresh themselves beside this beautiful oasis. Three tents and some
camels make up the party. From within two of the tents you hear muffled
voices, obviously surprised at your visit. Tall grass sways in a gentle
breeze. The open sky stretches overhead.

north.description: Some camels are tied up to a mass of stakes plugged into the ground.

south.description: Sand as far as the eye can see.

west.description: To the west lies Inside A Small Tent.

5057.name: Inside A Small Tent
5057.description:
This is a small and simple tent with few possessions in sight. Lying
here and there are young-looking men and women, possibly slaves to the
leader of this band. Tall grass sways in a gentle breeze. The ground is
soft underfoot.

east.description: To the east lies A Nomad Camp.

5058.name: Beside The Camels
5058.description:
Here stand about ten camels, all hitched to some stakes plugged into the
ground. To the east you see a small tent while to the north you see a
larger, fancier tent. The air is fresh and clean. Tall grass sways in a
gentle breeze.

north.description: This tent seems to be the temporary abode of the nomad leader.  You make a mental note to visit it before you leave.

east.description: In this tent there are very large men, all carrying weapons.

south.description: You see the center of the nomad camp.

5059.name: The Warrior's Tent
5059.description:
This tent has a few furnishings, but mainly it holds the band's
protectors. They all stare at you coldly as you enter. Wildflowers dot
the landscape. Tall grass sways in a gentle breeze.

west.description: Outside you see some peaceful camels.

5060.name: The Main Tent
5060.description:
This tent is as lavishly decorated on the inside as it is on the
outside. A fancy carpet lies on the sand and numerous baskets line the
walls. Tall grass sways in a gentle breeze. The ground is soft
underfoot.

east.description: An open path leads to The Main Tent

south.description: You see some peaceful camels.

5061.name: The Main Tent
5061.description:
This is where the leader of this band of nomads resides. He is
definitely rich as you inspect the tapestries, baskets, and a few
paintings as well. The air is fresh and clean. Wildflowers dot the
landscape.

west.description: You see the entrance to this tent.

205071.name: The Great Eastern Desert

north.description: To the north lies The Great Eastern Desert.

south.description: To the south lies The Great Eastern Desert.

205071.description:
A spine of red rock breaks out of the sand here, a ridge of weathered
stone that the wind has carved into fins and hollows. The trail
scrambles over it on ledges worn smooth by the feet of camels. From the
crest the dunes roll away under a white, blazing sky, broken far off by
the point of a pyramid. Heat beats up from the rock as from a forge, and
the trail drops north and south onto the sand.

12006.name: On A Wide River
12006.description:
A long boathouse of tarred timber straddles the river here on stout
piles, its roof spanning the water so that boats slide through beneath
the rafters as though down a dim hall. The river runs wide and brown
between the landing stages, slapping at the piles and filling the shed
with the smell of mud and weed. Lanterns hang from the beams, and iron
mooring rings are set along the walkways. Upstream the water opens west
toward the desert, downstream it runs east toward the sea, and a stair
climbs north to the canal quay.

north.description: You can see a city gate to the north.

east.description: To the east lies On A River Near The Sea.

west.description: To the west lies On A Wide River.

5086.name: On A River Near The Sea

north.description: To the north lies Port Halyon.

east.description: To the east lies Along The Shoreline.

west.description: To the west lies On A Wide River.

5086.description:
The river slows and spreads as it nears the sea, its brown water
swirling lazily between banks of reed and grey mud. Here the incoming
tide pushes back against the current, and your boat turns slowly in
confused little waves. North, the river opens into the harbour of Port
Halyon, and east it runs out along the shoreline to the sea. Upstream to
the west the river widens between its banks.

5251.name: The Chamber Of Fire

up.description: To the up lies The Great Eastern Desert.

down.description: To the down lies A Secret Cell.

5251.description:
Heat beats from a broad stone basin in the middle of this low chamber,
where a tongue of flame burns without wood or oil to feed it. The
sandstone walls are scorched black and scored with old glyphs that seem
to crawl in the shifting light. Fine sand trickles from the shaft
overhead, where worn footholds climb up to the glare of the open desert.
Beside the basin a square opening breathes cool, stale air, and narrow
steps lead down into the dark.

extra_descs.basin flame fire:
The basin is cut from a single block of red stone, its rim worn smooth
by the hands of those who warmed themselves here long ago. The flame
rises from a crack in its floor and never wavers, not even when a
draught stirs the sand.

5252.name: A Secret Cell

up.description: To the up lies The Chamber Of Fire.

5252.description:
This cramped cell was cut from the bedrock and meant to stay hidden, its
only way out a set of narrow steps climbing up toward the warmth and
light of the fire chamber. Rows of tally marks cover one wall, scratched
in groups of five until they run out of room. A stone bench is carved
from the rock along the other side, polished by long use. The air is
cool and dry, and every sound seems to die against the stone.

8800.name: Port Halyon

north.description: To the north lies On The Canal By The Ocean Side Unloading Dock.

east.description: To the east lies Outside The Port.

south.description: To the south lies On A River Near The Sea.

8800.description:
Your boat floats in the broad harbour of Port Halyon, sheltered behind
its stone moles from the worst of the sea. Quays of dressed stone line
the shore, crowded with warehouses, and the masts of moored ships
bristle against the sky. North lies the mouth of the canal and the great
crane of the unloading dock, east the narrow harbour entrance, and south
the mouth of the river. The water is green and smells of tar and fish.

8801.name: Along The Shoreline

east.description: To the east lies The Sea Of Storms.

south.description: To the south lies Along The Shoreline.

west.description: To the west lies End Of The Ocean Dock.

8801.description:
Your boat bobs in the lee of the ocean dock, where the water is dark
green and laced with weed. The shore curves away south in a line of
rocks and pale shingle, white with breaking foam. East of here the swell
lifts and lengthens as it rolls in from the Sea of Storms. The landing
stage at the end of the dock lies close by to the west.

8802.name: Along The Shoreline

north.description: To the north lies Along The Shoreline.

east.description: To the east lies The Sea Of Storms.

south.description: To the south lies Outside The Port.

west.description: To the west lies On The Canal By The Ocean Side Unloading Dock.

8802.description:
Your boat rocks in the choppy water off the mouth of the canal, where
brown town water spills into the sea and the smell of tar, fish and
rotting rope hangs over the waves. The unloading dock stands just to the
west, its great crane leaning out over the canal mouth. The shoreline
runs on north toward the ocean dock and south toward the harbour mouth.
Open sea lies east.

8803.name: Outside The Port

north.description: To the north lies Along The Shoreline.

east.description: To the east lies The Sea Of Storms.

south.description: To the south lies Along The Shoreline.

west.description: To the west lies Port Halyon.

8803.description:
Two long moles of piled stone reach out from the shore here to embrace
the harbour of Port Halyon, and between their heads lies the narrow
entrance to the west. On the end of the nearer mole stands the harbour
light, a squat round tower with a lantern room of iron and glass. The
water at the harbour mouth is choppy where the tide runs out against the
swell. The shoreline runs north and south, and the open sea lies east.

extra_descs.harbour light tower lantern:
The tower's stones are blackened by smoke and salt. Above its door a
weathered plaque reads: KEEP THE LIGHT AND THE LIGHT KEEPS YOU.

8804.name: Along The Shoreline

north.description: To the north lies Outside The Port.

east.description: To the east lies The Sea Of Storms.

west.description: To the west lies On A River Near The Sea.

8804.description:
Sandbars lie just beneath the surface along this stretch of shore, and
the waves break over them in long lines of white. On the land, a fringe
of salt marsh and reed beds marks where the river meets the sea, and to
the west the river's mouth opens between low, muddy banks. The harbour
moles stand to the north. Your boat can put out to open water east.

8805.name: The Sea Of Storms

east.description: To the east lies The Sea Of Storms.

south.description: To the south lies The Sea Of Storms.

west.description: To the west lies Along The Shoreline.

8805.description:
Clear of the dock, your boat meets the first real swell of the Sea of
Storms, and its bow rises and slaps down in a burst of spray. Back to
the west the roofs of Port Halyon huddle along the shore under a smudge
of chimney smoke. The water here is grey-green and cold, streaked with
foam. Open sea stretches away east and south as far as you can see.

8806.name: The Sea Of Storms

north.description: To the north lies The Sea Of Storms.

east.description: To the east lies The Sea Of Storms.

south.description: To the south lies The Sea Of Storms.

west.description: To the west lies Along The Shoreline.

8806.description:
Just off the coast the swell begins to gather strength, and your boat
lifts and falls on long grey waves that roll in from the open sea.
Looking back, you can see the canal mouth and the tall crane of the
unloading dock standing against the roofs of the port. The salt wind is
strong and steady. Open water lies north, east and south, and the
shoreline lies west.

8807.name: The Sea Of Storms

north.description: To the north lies The Sea Of Storms.

east.description: To the east lies The Sea Of Storms.

south.description: To the south lies The Sea Of Storms.

west.description: To the west lies Outside The Port.

8807.description:
This is the outer anchorage of Port Halyon, where ships wait for the
tide or a berth, and great mooring buoys of iron-banded timber bob on
the swell at intervals. The water is churned and dirty, streaked with
the slops of galleys. To the west the harbour light marks the entrance
to the port. Open sea lies north, east and south.

8808.name: The Sea Of Storms

north.description: To the north lies The Sea Of Storms.

east.description: To the east lies The Sea Of Storms.

south.description: To the south lies The Sea Of Storms.

west.description: To the west lies Along The Shoreline.

8808.description:
Brown river water fans out into the sea here, staining the green swell
with clouds of silt and carrying twigs, leaves and tufts of reed out
from the land. The meeting of fresh and salt water makes a ragged line
of froth across the surface. Behind you the harbour light stands on its
mole at the mouth of Port Halyon. Water lies open north, east and south,
and the shore is close to the west.

8809.name: The Sea Of Storms

north.description: To the north lies The Sea Of Storms.

east.description: To the east lies The Sea Of Storms.

8809.description:
The shore is close at hand here, a beach of grey shingle where the waves
break with a long, rattling roar as they drag the stones back with them.
Above the beach rise low cliffs of red earth, crumbling and furred with
grass. The surf is too strong to land in. Only to the north and east
does the water open out.

8810.name: The Sea Of Storms

east.description: To the east lies The Sea Of Storms.

south.description: To the south lies The Sea Of Storms.

west.description: To the west lies The Sea Of Storms.

8810.description:
A long, slow swell rolls under the hull, lifting the boat high enough to
glimpse the whole curve of the coast before dropping it into a trough of
green water. Ragged clouds race low overhead, and far out a squall
trails grey veils of rain across the horizon. Your boat's timbers creak
with every roll. The sea runs on east and south, and the port lies back
to the west.

8811.name: The Sea Of Storms

north.description: To the north lies The Sea Of Storms.

east.description: To the east lies The Sea Of Storms.

south.description: To the south lies The Sea Of Storms.

west.description: To the west lies The Sea Of Storms.

8811.description:
An old ship's hull lies at anchor here, dismasted and stripped, kept
afloat as a store hulk for the port. Her sides are black with tar and
patched with mismatched planks, and every gunport has been boarded shut.
The great anchor chain that holds her slants into the green water,
furred with weed. Around the hulk the sea lies open north, east, south
and west.

8812.name: The Sea Of Storms

north.description: To the north lies The Sea Of Storms.

east.description: To the east lies The Sea Of Storms.

south.description: To the south lies The Sea Of Storms.

west.description: To the west lies The Sea Of Storms.

8812.description:
A sandbank lies just beneath the surface here, a long pale tongue under
the green water, and the waves rear up and break as they pass over it.
At low tide its crest must show, for a stake has been driven into it
with a tattered red rag tied to the top. The water on either side of it
is deeper and calmer. You can steer around the bank to the north, east,
south or west.

8813.name: The Sea Of Storms

north.description: To the north lies The Sea Of Storms.

east.description: To the east lies The Sea Of Storms.

south.description: To the south lies The Sea Of Storms.

west.description: To the west lies The Sea Of Storms.

8813.description:
A row of tall stakes marches across the water here, the remains of a
fish weir built long ago by the people of the shore. Most of the wattle
between them has rotted away, leaving only the weathered posts, each
capped with a tuft of weed left by the last high tide. The current
hisses as it pours between them. Gaps in the old weir let your boat
through north, east, south or west.

8814.name: The Sea Of Storms

north.description: To the north lies The Sea Of Storms.

east.description: To the east lies The Sea Of Storms.

south.description: To the south lies The Sea Of Storms.

west.description: To the west lies The Sea Of Storms.

8814.description:
The coast draws close here, a line of red-brown cliffs with a narrow
cove biting into them to the south. The water near the cliffs is flecked
with foam and strewn with floating weed. Your boat rises and falls on a
swell that is beginning to feel the bottom. Open water lies north and
east, and the shore curves away to the west.

8815.name: The Sea Of Storms

north.description: To the north lies The Sea Of Storms.

8815.description:
Your boat has come into a narrow cove between red cliffs, where the
swell runs in long and smooth and breaks on a tiny beach of grey
pebbles. The cliffs rise so high and close that the light in here is dim
and green, and the sound of the waves echoes back and forth between
them. Ferns hang from the wet rock. The cove opens only to the north,
back to the sea.

8816.name: The Sea Of Storms

east.description: To the east lies The Sea Of Storms.

south.description: To the south lies The Sea Of Storms.

west.description: To the west lies The Sea Of Storms.

8816.description:
Spray whips off the wave crests here and stings your eyes with salt. A
bell buoy, anchored over some hidden shoal, clangs mournfully as it
heaves on the swell. The water around it is paler, almost jade, where
the sand rises close beneath the surface. The open sea continues east
and south, and the coast falls slowly away to the west.

extra_descs.bell buoy barrel:
The buoy is a squat iron barrel scabbed with barnacles, with a cracked
bronze bell hung in a cage on top. Every heave of the sea swings the
clapper, so that it is never quite silent.

8817.name: The Sea Of Storms

north.description: To the north lies The Sea Of Storms.

east.description: To the east lies The Sea Of Storms.

south.description: To the south lies The Sea Of Storms.

west.description: To the west lies The Sea Of Storms.

8817.description:
The wind has torn the clouds into long white streamers here, and the sun
comes and goes, chasing patches of light and shadow across the water.
The sea shifts colour with them, from green to grey to a bright, hard
blue. Behind you the towers of Port Halyon stand along the shore under a
haze of chimney smoke. The changing water runs on north, east, south and
west.

8818.name: The Sea Of Storms

north.description: To the north lies The Sea Of Storms.

east.description: To the east lies The Sea Of Storms.

south.description: To the south lies The Sea Of Storms.

west.description: To the west lies The Sea Of Storms.

8818.description:
A wreck lies on a hidden shoal here, a merchant ship heeled over on her
side with half her hull out of the water and her masts long gone. Waves
wash through the holes in her planking, and her name has been scoured
off her stern by the sea. The shoal around her is marked by a ring of
choppy, broken water. Clear of the shoal, the sea runs north, east,
south and west.

8819.name: The Sea Of Storms

north.description: To the north lies The Sea Of Storms.

east.description: To the east lies The Sea Of Storms.

south.description: To the south lies The Sea Of Storms.

west.description: To the west lies The Sea Of Storms.

8819.description:
A light rain falls on this stretch of sea, pocking the surface with
countless tiny craters and hushing the slap of the waves to a whisper.
The coast is a smudge of grey through the rain, without detail or
colour. Water drips from the brim of your hood and collects in the
bottom of the boat. Through the rain the sea lies open north, east,
south and west.

8820.name: The Sea Of Storms

north.description: To the north lies The Sea Of Storms.

east.description: To the east lies The Sea Of Storms.

west.description: To the west lies The Sea Of Storms.

8820.description:
A ridge of black boulders runs out from the shore here and blocks the
way like a wall, the swell heaving and bursting against it in white fans
of spray. Between the boulders, pools of trapped water flash in the
light. The rocks are slick with weed and cannot be crossed. Open water
lies north, east and west of the ridge.

8822.name: The Sea Of Storms

east.description: To the east lies The Sea Of Storms.

8822.description:
Your boat rides in a pocket of quiet water here, hemmed in by the long
spit of black rocks on one side and the shore on the other. The swell
can barely reach this corner, and the water lies still and brown with
sand stirred from the bottom. Weed rots in heaps along the rocks, and
the smell is thick and green. The only way out is east, back to open
water.

8823.name: The Sea Of Storms

east.description: To the east lies The Sea Of Storms.

south.description: To the south lies The Sea Of Storms.

west.description: To the west lies The Sea Of Storms.

8823.description:
The coast is only a dark line behind you now, and the sea has turned the
colour of slate. Whitecaps break all around, and a hard, steady wind
heels the boat over. Cold water slops in over the gunwale and swills
about your feet. Far out, a bank of thunderheads piles high on the
horizon, lit from within by silent flickers.

8824.name: The Sea Of Storms

north.description: To the north lies The Sea Of Storms.

east.description: To the east lies The Sea Of Storms.

south.description: To the south lies The Sea Of Storms.

west.description: To the west lies The Sea Of Storms.

8824.description:
A beacon stands here on a reef that barely breaks the surface, a tall
post of tarred timber topped with an iron basket for a fire. The basket
is cold and rusted, and the post leans at an angle, battered by years of
waves. Around its foot the water foams over the hidden rocks. Giving the
reef a wide berth, you may steer north, east, south or west.

8825.name: The Sea Of Storms

north.description: To the north lies The Sea Of Storms.

east.description: To the east lies The Sea Of Storms.

south.description: To the south lies The Sea Of Storms.

west.description: To the west lies The Sea Of Storms.

8825.description:
Nothing but water lies on every hand here, grey and restless under a sky
of low, racing cloud. The coast has sunk out of sight, and the only way
to judge your course is by the run of the swell and the set of the wind.
A lonely wind whistles over the wave tops. The sea stretches north,
east, south and west, and all four ways look alike.

8826.name: The Sea Of Storms

north.description: To the north lies The Sea Of Storms.

east.description: To the east lies The Sea Of Storms.

south.description: To the south lies The Sea Of Storms.

west.description: To the west lies The Sea Of Storms.

8826.description:
The water is shallow here over a broad bank of white sand, and the sea
turns a pale, milky green above it, glowing as if lit from beneath.
Ripples in the sand below mirror the ripples on the surface. A line of
great squared stones runs across the bank and out into the deeper water,
too regular to be anything but the work of hands. From the bank the sea
opens north, east, south and west.

8827.name: The Sea Of Storms

north.description: To the north lies The Sea Of Storms.

east.description: To the east lies The Sea Of Storms.

south.description: To the south lies The Sea Of Storms.

west.description: To the west lies The Sea Of Storms.

8827.description:
A slow whirlpool turns here, wide as a village green, its rim marked by
a ring of spinning foam and drifting weed. Your boat is drawn sideways
along the edge of it before you can pull clear, and the hull groans as
the water twists beneath. At its heart the sea sinks into a shallow,
glassy dimple. Pulling free of the rim, you can head north, east, south
or west.

8828.name: The Sea Of Storms

north.description: To the north lies The Sea Of Storms.

east.description: To the east lies The Sea Of Storms.

south.description: To the south lies The Sea Of Storms.

8828.description:
The end of a long spit of black boulders lies close beside your boat
here, reaching out from the shore and ending in a jumble of rocks that
the waves pour over. A crooked iron pole has been driven into the last
boulder as a warning, its tip hung with a tangle of old rope. There is
no way across the spit. Open water lies north, east and south.

8829.name: The Sea Of Storms

north.description: To the north lies The Sea Of Storms.

east.description: To the east lies The Sea Of Storms.

south.description: To the south lies The Sea Of Storms.

west.description: To the west lies The Sea Of Storms.

8829.description:
Gusts come off the land here in hot, sudden bursts, flattening the wave
tops and spinning little whirls of spray across the water. Between the
gusts the sea is strangely still. The spit of black rocks shows close
by, waves breaking white along its length. Water lies open north, east,
south and west, though the gusts make steering hard.

8830.name: The Sea Of Storms

north.description: To the north lies The Sea Of Storms.

east.description: To the east lies The Sea Of Storms.

8830.description:
The water is shallow and warm here, close under the shore, and the swell
rolls in long and lazy over a bottom of rippled sand. Beyond the
breakers the coast is low and bare, a waste of dunes with a few tufts of
grey grass. The bleached ribs of an old fishing boat stick up from the
beach like the bones of some great fish. The sea runs north and east
from these shallows.

8831.name: The Sea Of Storms

east.description: To the east lies The Sea Of Storms.

south.description: To the south lies The Sea Of Storms.

west.description: To the west lies The Sea Of Storms.

8831.description:
A broken mast juts from the sea here at a drunken angle, all that shows
of some ship that foundered on a shoal. Weed streams from its crosstree,
and the swell breaks white around its foot. The water is clear enough
that you can make out the dark ribs of the hull beneath the surface.
Open sea runs east and south, and the long way back to port lies west.

extra_descs.mast wreck crosstree:
The mast is as thick as a man's waist and still wears a few turns of
rotten rigging. A board is nailed to it just above the waterline, but
whatever was painted there has long since been scoured away.

8832.name: The Sea Of Storms

north.description: To the north lies The Sea Of Storms.

east.description: To the east lies The Sea Of Storms.

south.description: To the south lies The Sea Of Storms.

west.description: To the west lies The Sea Of Storms.

8832.description:
The bottom falls away here into deep water, and the sea changes from
green to a dark, inky blue. The swell grows longer and heavier, and your
boat begins to rise and fall in a slow rhythm that makes the stomach
lurch. Behind you the coast has dwindled to a low grey line. Deep water
spreads north, east, south and west.

8833.name: The Sea Of Storms

north.description: To the north lies The Sea Of Storms.

east.description: To the east lies The Sea Of Storms.

south.description: To the south lies The Sea Of Storms.

west.description: To the west lies The Sea Of Storms.

8833.description:
A strong current sets across this stretch of sea, and you must row hard
just to hold your place, the water streaming past the hull in long,
twisting ropes. It flows toward a black stack of rock that juts from the
sea not far off like a broken tooth. The waves are short and confused
where the current meets the swell. Fighting the current, you may still
make way north, east, south or west.

8834.name: The Sea Of Storms

north.description: To the north lies The Sea Of Storms.

east.description: To the east lies The Sea Of Storms.

south.description: To the south lies The Sea Of Storms.

west.description: To the west lies The Sea Of Storms.

8834.description:
Through the clear green water a sunken road can be seen, its great slabs
cracked and tilted as if by some ancient upheaval. A carved stone head
as big as your boat lies on its side among them, gazing up at you with
blank, weed-fringed eyes. Long weed streams from its open mouth like a
beard. Your boat can pass over the ruins to the north, east, south or
west.

extra_descs.head carved stone statue:
The head wears a tall crown of tapering points, and its features are not
quite those of any people you know: the brow too high, the eyes set too
far apart. Its lips are parted as if it died in the middle of a word.

8835.name: The Sea Of Storms

north.description: To the north lies The Sea Of Storms.

east.description: To the east lies The Sea Of Storms.

south.description: To the south lies The Sea Of Storms.

west.description: To the west lies The Sea Of Storms.

8835.description:
The sea is calm here beneath a high, hazy sky, and the sun lays a path
of dazzling white across the water that hurts to look at. Your boat
rocks gently on a low swell. A raft of driftwood and tangled rope has
been caught in some trick of the currents and turns slowly in place,
going nowhere. The glittering water lies open north, east, south and
west.

8836.name: The Sea Of Storms

north.description: To the north lies The Sea Of Storms.

east.description: To the east lies The Sea Of Storms.

south.description: To the south lies The Sea Of Storms.

west.description: To the west lies The Sea Of Storms.

8836.description:
The wind blows steadily here from the land, carrying a fine dust that
settles on the water and on your boat, gritty and warm. It smells of hot
stone and dry grass, the breath of the desert beyond the coast. The
waves are low and orderly, marching away from the shore in neat ranks.
Dusty water lies open north, east, south and west.

8837.name: The Sea Of Storms

north.description: To the north lies The Sea Of Storms.

east.description: To the east lies The Sea Of Storms.

south.description: To the south lies The Sea Of Storms.

west.description: To the west lies The Sea Of Storms.

8837.description:
A sheen of dark oil spreads across the water here, painting the swells
with slow rainbows, and a smell of rancid fish hangs over it. It wells
up from somewhere far below, perhaps from the cargo of a whaler lying on
the sea floor. Your oars come up black and greasy. Beyond the slick the
sea runs clean to the north, east, south and west.

8838.name: The Sea Of Storms

north.description: To the north lies The Sea Of Storms.

east.description: To the east lies The Sea Of Storms.

south.description: To the south lies The Sea Of Storms.

west.description: To the west lies The Sea Of Storms.

8838.description:
Long lines of foam stretch across the water here, marking a meeting of
currents where the sea is wrinkled and choppy. Your boat jolts as it
crosses each line, and the bow swings of its own accord. Away beyond the
low waves, a coast of pale sand shimmers in the heat haze. Across the
choppy lines you may steer north, east, south or west.

8839.name: The Sea Of Storms

north.description: To the north lies The Sea Of Storms.

east.description: To the east lies The Sea Of Storms.

8839.description:
Dunes of pale gold come down almost to the water's edge here, and the
breakers roll up a broad beach of sand so bright in the sun that it
hurts the eyes. Hot wind blows off the land, and grains of sand patter
on the boards of your boat. The surf is far too heavy to beach a boat
safely. Open water lies north and east.

8840.name: The Sea Of Storms

east.description: To the east lies The Sea Of Storms.

south.description: To the south lies The Sea Of Storms.

west.description: To the west lies The Sea Of Storms.

8840.description:
Rain sweeps across the water in hissing curtains, flattening the wave
tops and blurring the horizon into grey nothing. Your boat wallows in a
confused sea, struck by waves from two sides at once. Water streams from
your hair and runs in cold trickles inside your collar. The rain thins a
little to the east, while south and west the sea vanishes into murk.

8841.name: The Sea Of Storms

north.description: To the north lies The Sea Of Storms.

east.description: To the east lies The Sea Of Storms.

south.description: To the south lies The Sea Of Storms.

west.description: To the west lies The Sea Of Storms.

8841.description:
Here the sea is a dull pewter grey under a low, unbroken sky, and a cold
drizzle hangs in the air without ever quite falling. The swell is short
and choppy, and your boat bucks and slaps from one wave to the next.
Ahead, the sheer black shape of a sea stack shows through the murk. Grey
water spreads north, east, south and west.

8842.name: The Sea Of Storms

north.description: To the north lies The Sea Of Storms.

south.description: To the south lies The Sea Of Storms.

west.description: To the west lies The Sea Of Storms.

8842.description:
Waves smash against the flank of the great black stack just beyond your
bow, and the backwash shoves your boat away from the rock in a smother
of foam. At the waterline the stone is crusted thick with mussels and
barnacles, and long ropes of weed stream from it in the surge. Close as
it is, the rock offers no landing and no way past. Open water lies
north, south and west.

8843.name: The Sea Of Storms

north.description: To the north lies The Sea Of Storms.

east.description: To the east lies The Sea Of Storms.

south.description: To the south lies The Sea Of Storms.

west.description: To the west lies The Sea Of Storms.

8843.description:
Beneath your boat, through water as clear as green glass, a line of
great squared stones runs along the sea floor, straight as a road and
far too regular to be the work of the sea. Weed waves from the joints
between them, and here and there a fallen column lies across the line.
The drowned road seems to lead on toward the distant Basalt Pillars. The
sea is open all around, north, east, south and west.

8844.name: The Sea Of Storms

north.description: To the north lies The Sea Of Storms.

east.description: To the east lies The Sea Of Storms.

south.description: To the south lies The Sea Of Storms.

west.description: To the west lies The Sea Of Storms.

8844.description:
Kelp grows up from the sea floor here in a vast swaying forest, and its
long brown fronds reach the surface and spread out in a slick, rubbery
mat. Your oars tangle in it at every stroke, and the boat slows almost
to a stop. Beneath the canopy of weed the water is shadowed and still.
Clear channels lead out of the kelp to the north, east, south and west.

8845.name: The Sea Of Storms

north.description: To the north lies The Sea Of Storms.

east.description: To the east lies The Sea Of Storms.

south.description: To the south lies The Sea Of Storms.

west.description: To the west lies The Sea Of Storms.

8845.description:
Thunder rolls over this stretch of sea from a storm that stalks the
horizon on long legs of rain. Every few heartbeats lightning shivers
down into the water far off, and the whole sea flashes white and then
goes dark again. The air tingles and smells sharp, like struck flint.
The waves are building, and the storm-lit water stretches north, east,
south and west.

8846.name: The Sea Of Storms

north.description: To the north lies The Sea Of Storms.

east.description: To the east lies The Sea Of Storms.

south.description: To the south lies The Sea Of Storms.

west.description: To the west lies The Sea Of Storms.

8846.description:
The sea runs in long, tall rollers here, so steep that your boat stands
almost on its stern as it climbs each one and then plunges into the
trough beyond. At the top of each wave you glimpse a far line of pale
dunes; at the bottom, nothing but grey walls of water. The wind hums in
the oarlocks. The rollers march on unbroken north, east, south and west.

8847.name: The Sea Of Storms

north.description: To the north lies The Sea Of Storms.

east.description: To the east lies The Sea Of Storms.

south.description: To the south lies The Sea Of Storms.

west.description: To the west lies The Sea Of Storms.

8847.description:
A cold current wells up from the depths here, and the water turns
suddenly dark and clear, so clear that you can gaze down into a blue
gloom without a bottom. The chill rising from it makes your breath smoke
even by day. Far below, faint shapes like the tops of towers seem to
show and fade again as the light shifts. Above that abyss your boat may
go north, east, south or west.

8848.name: The Sea Of Storms

north.description: To the north lies The Sea Of Storms.

west.description: To the west lies The Sea Of Storms.

8848.description:
The surf booms against a low cliff of crumbling yellow sandstone here,
carved by the waves into arches, pillars and caves. Sand streams from
the clifftop in thin, glittering falls whenever the wind gusts. The sea
heaves and sucks among the rocks at the cliff foot. Your boat can stand
off from the cliff to the north or the west.

8849.name: The Sea Of Storms

east.description: To the east lies The Sea Of Storms.

south.description: To the south lies The Sea Of Storms.

west.description: To the west lies The Sea Of Storms.

8849.description:
Long rollers march out of the east in endless ranks, each one lifting
your boat and passing on beneath it toward the distant shore. Between
them the troughs are deep enough to hide the horizon, so that for a
moment there is nothing but walls of moving water. A cold wind drives
flecks of foam across the surface like blown snow. To the south the sea
grows darker still.

8850.name: The Sea Of Storms

north.description: To the north lies The Sea Of Storms.

east.description: To the east lies The Sea Of Storms.

west.description: To the west lies The Sea Of Storms.

8850.description:
The black stack of rock looms close by here, so near that its shadow
falls across your boat and turns the water beneath it the colour of ink.
Its base is fringed with jagged ledges over which the swell pours in
sheets of white, and the roar of it fills the air. No boat could pass
the rock, but open water leads north, east and west.

8852.name: The Sea Of Storms

east.description: To the east lies The Sea Of Storms.

south.description: To the south lies The Sea Of Storms.

west.description: To the west lies The Sea Of Storms.

8852.description:
The great stack of black rock towers close above your boat here, its
face scored by deep cracks where the sea has been working at it for
ages. A shelf of tumbled boulders lies at its foot, and the swell sucks
and gurgles among them like something breathing. The black columns of
the Basalt Pillars crowd the view not far beyond. Away from the rock,
the water runs east, south and west.

8853.name: The Sea Of Storms

north.description: To the north lies The Sea Of Storms.

east.description: To the east lies The Basalt Pillars Of Stethelos.

south.description: To the south lies The Sea Of Storms.

west.description: To the west lies The Sea Of Storms.

8853.description:
A drowned road surfaces here, or nearly: the tops of its great squared
stones show just beneath the water, and waves break over them in a long
white line that leads east to the foot of the Basalt Pillars. Beside it
stand the stumps of two fluted columns, green with weed, that may once
have flanked a gate. A careless oarsman could rip the bottom out of his
boat on the stones. Deeper water lies north, south and west.

8854.name: The Sea Of Storms

north.description: To the north lies The Sea Of Storms.

east.description: To the east lies The Sea Of Storms.

south.description: To the south lies The Sea Of Storms.

west.description: To the west lies The Sea Of Storms.

8854.description:
A thick sea fog has settled over the water here, so dense that the bow
of your boat fades into it. Sounds carry strangely: the slap of waves,
the creak of the oars, and now and then a deep boom from somewhere close
by, where the sea strikes stone. The fog smells of brine and of
something older, like a cellar long shut. Blindly you may steer north,
east, south or west.

8855.name: The Sea Of Storms

north.description: To the north lies The Sea Of Storms.

east.description: To the east lies The Sea Of Storms.

south.description: To the south lies The Sea Of Storms.

west.description: To the west lies The Sea Of Storms.

8855.description:
A squall of hail sweeps across the water, rattling off the boards of
your boat and beating the sea into a dimpled grey. The wind gusts from
all sides at once, and the waves stand up short and steep, slopping over
the bow. Through a rent in the cloud you glimpse the dark cliffs of an
island not far off. When the squall passes, the way will lie open north,
east, south and west.

8856.name: The Sea Of Storms

north.description: To the north lies The Sea Of Storms.

west.description: To the west lies The Sea Of Storms.

8856.description:
The swell rolls in from the open sea and breaks over a line of submerged
rocks here, throwing up fountains of spray that drift across your boat
like rain. A broken spar wedged between two of the rocks is all that
remains of some vessel that found them first. Past the reef the sea is a
churning white maze that no boat could survive. Calmer water lies north
and west.

8857.name: The Sea Of Storms

east.description: To the east lies The Sea Of Storms.

south.description: To the south lies The Sea Of Storms.

west.description: To the west lies The Sea Of Storms.

8857.description:
The wind drops almost to nothing here, and the sea heaves in a sullen,
oily calm beneath a sky the colour of lead. The air smells sharply of
the coming storm, and the hair on your arms prickles. Far off to the
east a pale waterspout twists from the clouds and stalks across the
water. The same eerie stillness lies over the sea to the south and west.

8858.name: The Sea Of Storms

north.description: To the north lies The Sea Of Storms.

east.description: To the east lies The Sea Of Storms.

south.description: To the south lies The Sea Of Storms.

west.description: To the west lies The Sea Of Storms.

8858.description:
Out here the swell runs long and heavy, and your boat climbs each grey
ridge slowly before sliding down its back into the trough. Tangled mats
of yellow weed drift on the surface, lifting and falling with the water.
Far off, the dark columns of the Basalt Pillars break the horizon like
the teeth of a broken comb. Not a sail shows anywhere on the sea that
stretches north, east, south and west.

8859.name: The Sea Of Storms

north.description: To the north lies The Sea Of Storms.

east.description: To the east lies The Sea Of Storms.

south.description: To the south lies The Sea Of Storms.

8859.description:
A great black stack of rock rises from the sea close beside your boat,
its sides sheer and streaked with white, its top crowned with a ragged
tuft of grass. The swell breaks against it with a deep, shuddering thud
you can feel through the hull. There is no landing anywhere on its
walls. Open water runs north and east, and the tall shapes of the Basalt
Pillars stand not far off to the south.

8860.name: The Sea Of Storms

north.description: To the north lies The Sea Of Storms.

east.description: To the east lies The Sea Of Storms.

south.description: To the south lies The Basalt Pillars Of Stethelos.

west.description: To the west lies The Sea Of Storms.

8860.description:
The Basalt Pillars rise just south of here, and already the current
among them reaches out to tug at your boat, turning its bow this way and
that. The water is laced with long streaks of foam that all point the
same way, like the lines on a sailor's chart. Somewhere among the
columns a hollow booming sounds at every swell. Easier water lies north,
east and west.

8861.name: The Basalt Pillars Of Stethelos

north.description: To the north lies The Sea Of Storms.

east.description: To the east lies The Sea Of Storms.

south.description: To the south lies The Sea Of Storms.

west.description: To the west lies The Sea Of Storms.

8861.description:
Your boat drifts among the Basalt Pillars Of Stethelos, a forest of six-
sided columns of black stone that rise sheer from the sea, some taller
than any tower in Port Halyon, others broken off into stumps barely
awash. The currents swirl between them in contrary directions, so that
the water seems to boil without heat. Sounds echo strangely here, coming
back from the stone a heartbeat late. Channels open between the pillars
to the north, east, south and west.

extra_descs.pillars columns basalt carving band:
A man's height above the water, the tallest pillar is ringed by a band
of carving: a crowned figure standing with arms outstretched while
storms rage on every side. Sailors say Stethelos was a sea-king who
bound the winds here, and that the pillars are the posts of his drowned
hall.

8862.name: The Sea Of Storms

north.description: To the north lies The Basalt Pillars Of Stethelos.

east.description: To the east lies The Sea Of Storms.

south.description: To the south lies The Sea Of Storms.

west.description: To the west lies The Sea Of Storms.

8862.description:
The Basalt Pillars stand just to the north, a cluster of black columns
so tall that the low clouds seem to snag on them, and the swell piles up
white against their bases. The water here is deep and dark, cold enough
that the spray stings like sleet. Away to the east the cliffs of an
island loom out of the haze. Southward and westward the open sea heaves
in long grey ridges.

8863.name: The Sea Of Storms

north.description: To the north lies The Sea Of Storms.

west.description: To the west lies The Sea Of Storms.

8863.description:
The water runs fast and smooth here over a reef just beneath the
surface, and your boat slides along it as if on a sheet of green glass.
Where the reef ends, the sea breaks in a line of white water that no
boat could cross. Beyond the breakers the black cliffs of the Island of
Morvoct rise sheer out of the sea. The only safe water lies north and
west.

8864.name: The Sea Of Storms

east.description: To the east lies The Sea Of Storms.

south.description: To the south lies The Sea Of Storms.

west.description: To the west lies The Sea Of Storms.

8864.description:
Out here no land shows in any direction, and the sea is a heaving plain
of dark water under a low ceiling of cloud. The wind keens over the
waves and fills your ears with a ceaseless roar. Your boat climbs each
swell sluggishly, heavy with bilge water. The waves roll on east and
south without end, and the way back lies west.

8865.name: The Sea Of Storms

north.description: To the north lies The Sea Of Storms.

east.description: To the east lies The Sea Of Storms.

south.description: To the south lies The Sea Of Storms.

west.description: To the west lies The Sea Of Storms.

8865.description:
Here the wind has torn the cloud apart, and a hard blue sky shows
through the gaps. Sunlight flashes off the wave tops so brightly that
you must squint, and the sea turns from grey to a cold, glittering
green. Spray dries to a crust of salt on your skin and clothes. The
broad sea rolls on in every direction, its darker water lying south.

8866.name: The Sea Of Storms

north.description: To the north lies The Sea Of Storms.

east.description: To the east lies The Sea Of Storms.

south.description: To the south lies The Sea Of Storms.

west.description: To the west lies The Sea Of Storms.

8866.description:
A deep, sullen swell rolls in from the south, each wave long, smooth-
backed and heavy with the weight of the open ocean. Your boat rides them
easily enough, rising and falling like a slow breath. Now and then a
gust lifts a fine smoke of spindrift from the crests. Open water spreads
east, west and north.

8867.name: The Sea Of Storms

north.description: To the north lies The Sea Of Storms.

east.description: To the east lies The Sea Of Storms.

south.description: To the south lies The Sea Of Storms.

west.description: To the west lies The Sea Of Storms.

8867.description:
Dark tide rips cut across the sea here, lines of brown, frothing water
where two currents grind together. Your boat lurches as it crosses one,
spinning half about before you can steady it. Weed and splintered
driftwood gather along the rips in long, ragged windrows. Southward,
tall dark shapes rise from the water at the edge of sight.

8868.name: The Sea Of Storms

north.description: To the north lies The Sea Of Storms.

east.description: To the east lies The Sea Of Storms.

south.description: To the south lies The Sea Of Storms.

west.description: To the west lies The Basalt Pillars Of Stethelos.

8868.description:
To the west the Basalt Pillars of Stethelos rise from the sea, great
columns of black stone standing in a ragged rank like the ruins of some
drowned hall. The swell booms hollowly among their feet and throws up
fountains of spray. The water around your boat is restless, eddying back
from the pillars in sudden swirls. Open sea lies north, east and south.

extra_descs.pillars basalt columns stethelos:
Each pillar is six-sided, as neat as if a mason had cut it, and the
tallest stand higher than a ship's mast. Sailors say they are the
gateposts of a city the sea swallowed long ago, and that in a dead calm
its bells can still be heard.

8869.name: The Sea Of Storms

north.description: To the north lies The Sea Of Storms.

south.description: To the south lies The Southern Sea Of Storms.

west.description: To the west lies The Sea Of Storms.

8869.description:
The cliffs of the Island of Morvoct rise close at hand here, black and
streaked with salt, and the swell surges against their foot in great
bursts of spray. A cave mouth gapes in the cliff to the south, broad
enough to take a boat, and the sea runs into it with a hollow roar. Your
boat lurches and spins in the backwash. Open water lies north and west,
back toward the Basalt Pillars.

8870.name: The Sea Of Storms

east.description: To the east lies The Sea Of Storms.

south.description: To the south lies The Sea Of Storms.

west.description: To the west lies The Sea Of Storms.

8870.description:
Lightning cracks across the sky close by, and the thunder that follows
seems to shake the water itself. In the flash you glimpse the whole sea
in white and black, every crest frozen for an instant. Rain drums on
your shoulders and dances in pale spikes on the surface. Toward the east
the sky shows a sickly yellow light, while south the water runs into
deeper darkness.

8871.name: The Sea Of Storms

north.description: To the north lies The Sea Of Storms.

east.description: To the east lies The Sea Of Storms.

south.description: To the south lies The Sea Of Storms.

west.description: To the west lies The Sea Of Storms.

8871.description:
The sea here is a deep ink-blue, so dark that the waves look carved from
stone until they break. Cold water wells up from the depths and chills
the air, so that your breath smokes. Foam lies on the surface in long
streaks that point the way the wind is blowing. Water stretches north,
east, south and west, with no landmark to steer by.

8872.name: The Sea Of Storms

north.description: To the north lies The Sea Of Storms.

east.description: To the east lies The Sea Of Storms.

south.description: To the south lies The Sea Of Storms.

west.description: To the west lies The Sea Of Storms.

8872.description:
Patches of fog drift across the water from the east like slow grey
sails. Between them the sea glitters under a stray shaft of sunlight,
then dulls again to pewter. A raft of brown weed and cork net floats
turns slowly in an eddy, rising and falling with the waves. The swell
runs north and south, and open water spreads west.

8873.name: The Sea Of Storms

north.description: To the north lies The Sea Of Storms.

east.description: To the east lies The Sea Of Storms.

south.description: To the south lies The Sea Of Storms.

west.description: To the west lies The Sea Of Storms.

8873.description:
The boom of the reef carries from the east, and now and then a gust
brings a fine salt rain of its spray. The water here is choppy and
confused, its crests slapping at the hull from every side. A gnarled
log, bleached silver by sun and salt, rolls lazily in the swell. Open
sea stretches north, south and west.

8874.name: The Sea Of Storms

north.description: To the north lies The Sea Of Storms.

south.description: To the south lies In the Ocean.

west.description: To the west lies The Sea Of Storms.

8874.description:
Here the Sea of Storms gives way to the open ocean, and its short, angry
chop smooths into a long and powerful swell. The water deepens to a
clear, bottomless blue. Southward a current gathers strength and flows
away into the ocean, while the rougher sea lies north. The basalt
pillars stand dark and distant to the west.

8875.name: The Sea Of Storms

south.description: To the south lies The Sea Of Storms.

west.description: To the west lies The Sea Of Storms.

8875.description:
Here the swell runs into a belt of broken, churning water, as if the sea
itself refused to go any further. Beyond it lies only spume and a wall
of fog that nothing can pierce. Your boat yaws and twists in the
turmoil, its oars biting on foam. Calmer water lies south, and the long
road home runs back west.

8876.name: The Sea Of Storms

north.description: To the north lies The Sea Of Storms.

south.description: To the south lies The Sea Of Storms.

west.description: To the west lies The Sea Of Storms.

8876.description:
A strong current runs along the edge of the sea here, setting your boat
steadily south whether you will or no. The water is a deep, clear blue
and bitterly cold, and long ropes of kelp sway in its depths. A grey
wall of fog hangs beyond the current, hiding whatever lies past it.
Broken water churns to the north, and westward the open sea rolls on.

8877.name: The Sea Of Storms

north.description: To the north lies The Sea Of Storms.

south.description: To the south lies The Sea Of Storms.

west.description: To the west lies The Sea Of Storms.

8877.description:
Fog creeps out over the water here, and the world shrinks to a few boat
lengths of grey sea. Sounds carry strangely, so that the slap of a wave
seems to come from overhead and once you could swear you hear a bell.
Mist beads on the gunwales and drips from your eyebrows. The current
tugs you on south, though clearer water lies west and the way north is
open.

8878.name: The Sea Of Storms

north.description: To the north lies The Sea Of Storms.

west.description: To the west lies The Sea Of Storms.

8878.description:
The current bends sharply here around a reef of black rock that breaks
the surface in a long line of foam. Waves burst against it with a deep,
hollow boom, and spray hangs over the rocks in a drifting veil. No boat
could pass through those breakers. The current swings back north along
the fog, and open water lies west.

8879.name: The Sea Of Storms

north.description: To the north lies The Sea Of Storms.

east.description: To the east lies The Sea Of Storms.

south.description: To the south lies The Basalt Pillars Of Stethelos.

8879.description:
North of the Basalt Pillars the current takes hold of your boat and
pulls it sideways in a long, curving glide, as if the sea itself were
circling something. The columns crowd close behind to the south, their
black flanks glistening with spray. Patches of foam spin slowly on the
surface, gathered into rings. Clear water lies north, while to the east
the current runs on in its strange sweep.

8880.name: The Sea Of Storms

north.description: To the north lies The Sea Of Storms.

south.description: To the south lies The Sea Of Storms.

west.description: To the west lies The Sea Of Storms.

8880.description:
The current that sweeps around the Basalt Pillars runs strongest here,
and your boat is carried along on it like a leaf in a millrace. The
pillars wheel slowly past, black against the sky, and it is hard to be
sure which side of them you are on. Eddies twist the water into whirling
knots. The current pulls south, while calmer water lies north and the
way back runs west.

8881.name: The Sea Of Storms

north.description: To the north lies The Sea Of Storms.

south.description: To the south lies The Sea Of Storms.

west.description: To the west lies The Basalt Pillars Of Stethelos.

8881.description:
Here the current doubles back on itself, and the water heaps up in a
standing wave that never breaks and never moves, a ridge of green glass
humming with power. Your boat slides along its foot. The Basalt Pillars
rise close to the west, and between them the sea seethes white. The
current runs on north and south.

8882.name: The Sea Of Storms

north.description: To the north lies The Sea Of Storms.

west.description: To the west lies The Sea Of Storms.

8882.description:
The current slackens here in a pool of black, glassy water ringed by
reefs that show as dark shadows beneath the surface. Nothing breaks the
stillness but the drip from your oars. The Basalt Pillars stand
somewhere behind you, though when you look for them they seem to have
moved. Channels between the reefs lead north and west.

8883.name: The Sea Of Storms

north.description: To the north lies The Basalt Pillars Of Stethelos.

east.description: To the east lies The Sea Of Storms.

south.description: To the south lies The Sea Of Storms.

west.description: To the west lies The Sea Of Storms.

8883.description:
The currents here pull four ways at once, and your boat turns in slow
circles no matter how you steer. The Basalt Pillars loom to the north,
closer than they should be, though you were sure they lay behind you. A
narrow race of fast water leads east between two reefs, and the open sea
lies south and west. Mist drifts across the water in thin, curling
veils.

8884.name: The Sea Of Storms

north.description: To the north lies The Sea Of Storms.

8884.description:
Your boat shoots through a narrow race between two long reefs, the water
roaring white on either side and the hull shuddering as it skims the
shallows. Spray hangs in the air like smoke. There is no turning back
against a current this strong. The race bends and carries you on toward
the north, where the water flattens and turns a strange, deep green.

8885.name: The Sea Of Storms

north.description: To the north lies The Sea Of Storms.

south.description: To the south lies The Sea Of Storms.

west.description: To the west lies The Gate To Lost Carcosa.

8885.description:
The water here is a deep, unnatural green, and light seems to rise from
somewhere far below it, glowing faintly through the swell. To the west a
great arch of green stone stands out of the sea, and the waves seem to
bow as they pass beneath it. The open sea lies north, and the roaring
race leads back south. The air is utterly still, and the sound of the
surf seems very far away.

8886.name: The Gate To Lost Carcosa

north.description: To the north lies The Sea Of Storms.

east.description: To the east lies The Sea Of Storms.

west.description: To the west lies The Sea Of Storms.

down.description: To the down lies The Green Stairs Of Faith.

8886.description:
A colossal arch of green stone rises out of the sea here, its pillars
carved with spiralling figures worn smooth by ages of waves. Beneath it
the sea does a thing that the sea should not do: it parts in a ring
around a dark stairwell, held back as if by glass, and green stairs wind
down into the depths. The water around the gate is calm and silent. Open
sea lies north, east and west, and the stairs lead down.

extra_descs.arch figures carvings pillars:
The figures climb the pillars in a spiral toward the keystone: crowned
men and women first, then robed ones, then shapes that are less and less
like people. On the keystone itself is carved a single tower beneath a
crescent of black stars.

8887.name: The Green Stairs Of Faith

west.description: To the west lies A Room Of Death.

up.description: To the up lies The Gate To Lost Carcosa.

down.description: To the down lies The Green Stairs Of Faith.

8887.description:
The stairs wind down through a shaft of green stone, polished and
translucent, through which the sea can be seen pressing on every side,
dim and silent. The steps are narrow and worn into hollows by feet long
gone, and there is no rail. Above, a circle of grey light marks the
gate; below, the stairs turn out of sight into darkness. A heavy door of
green bronze is set in the wall to the west.

8888.name: The Green Stairs Of Faith

north.description: To the north lies A Room Of Death.

south.description: To the south lies A Room Of Death.

up.description: To the up lies The Green Stairs Of Faith.

down.description: To the down lies The Green Stairs Of Faith.

8888.description:
Midway down, the green stairs pass through a landing where the walls
grow thick and opaque, and the light of the sea fades to a faint emerald
glow from the stone itself. Archways open north and south off the
landing, both leading into the same round chamber beyond. The steps
continue up toward the gate and down into a deepening silence. Faint
words are cut into each step, most of them worn almost away.

extra_descs.words steps letters:
Where the words can still be made out, each step bears a single one, and
read in order they make a kind of prayer: DO NOT LOOK DOWN, DO NOT LOOK
BACK, THE STAIR IS THERE IF YOU BELIEVE IT.

8889.name: The Green Stairs Of Faith

north.description: To the north lies A Room Of Death.

east.description: To the east lies Lost Carcosa.

west.description: To the west lies A Room Of Death.

up.description: To the up lies The Green Stairs Of Faith.

8889.description:
The green stairs end here at a small landing deep below the sea, where
the air is cold and still and smells of dust rather than salt. A tall
door of black bronze stands in the east wall, cold to the touch, and a
draught moves beneath it with a faint sigh. An open archway to the north
and a smaller door to the west both lead into a low vault. The stairs
climb up into the green glow.

8890.name: A Room Of Death

north.description: To the north lies The Green Stairs Of Faith.

east.description: To the east lies The Green Stairs Of Faith.

south.description: To the south lies The Green Stairs Of Faith.

west.description: To the west lies The Green Stairs Of Faith.

8890.description:
This round chamber has four doorways, one in each wall, and every one of
them opens back onto the green stairs, though never quite where you
entered. Skeletons sit slumped against the walls between the doorways,
dozens of them, as if they wandered from door to door until they could
walk no more. The air is dead and dry, and the dust on the floor is
printed with circling footsteps. North, south, east or west, the stairs
wait.

8891.name: A Room Of Death

east.description: To the east lies The Green Stairs Of Faith.

south.description: To the south lies The Green Stairs Of Faith.

8891.description:
A long, low vault stretches away from the stairs, lined on both sides
with stone coffins whose heavy lids have been pushed aside, all from
within. Grave dust lies thick on everything, and the coffins hold
nothing now but scraps of yellowed linen. Carved on the end wall is a
great relief of a robed figure whose face is hidden behind a pale mask.
A door leads east back to the stairs, and an archway to the south opens
onto them as well.

8892.name: Lost Carcosa

east.description: To the east lies In The Streets Of Dim Carcosa.

west.description: To the west lies The Green Stairs Of Faith.

8892.description:
The bronze door opens in the foot of a great wall, and beyond it lies a
city that cannot be here: Lost Carcosa, its towers rising into a dim sky
where black stars hang even by day. The air is still and cool and
utterly silent, without wind, bird or voice. Two pale suns sit low
behind a haze, and every shadow is long. A broad street leads east into
the city, and the door in the wall leads back west to the stairs.

8893.name: In The Streets Of Dim Carcosa

east.description: To the east lies In The Streets Of Dim Carcosa.

west.description: To the west lies Lost Carcosa.

8893.description:
Tall houses of grey stone line this street, their windows empty and
dark, their doors standing open on rooms where nothing stirs. Grey dust
lies over the paving in a smooth, unbroken layer, so fine that it rises
in slow clouds at every step and hangs in the air behind you. High
above, slender towers lean together against the dim sky. The street runs
east deeper into the city and west back toward the great wall.

8894.name: In The Streets Of Dim Carcosa

east.description: To the east lies Before the Black Building.

west.description: To the west lies In The Streets Of Dim Carcosa.

8894.description:
A dry fountain stands in the middle of this street, its basin cracked
and its centrepiece a statue of a woman whose face has been chiselled
away. Rags of banners that were once yellow hang from poles on the
housefronts, faded almost to grey and stirring though there is no wind.
Ahead to the east the street opens before a building of utter black. The
way back runs west between the silent houses.

8895.name: Before the Black Building

north.description: To the north lies In The Streets Of Dim Carcosa.

east.description: To the east lies The Black Building.

south.description: To the south lies In The Streets Of Dim Carcosa.

west.description: To the west lies In The Streets Of Dim Carcosa.

8895.description:
The street opens here into a silent square before the Black Building, a
windowless mass of stone so dark that it seems less a building than a
hole cut in the dim air. Its only door, a slab of black metal without
handle or hinge, stands in the east face. Streets lead north and south
from the square, and the way back runs west. Underfoot the paving is
laid in a spiral that winds toward the door.

extra_descs.door metal slab black:
The door is cold enough to sting the fingers. When you lay your palm
against it, you hear, very faintly, the sound of something enormous
breathing far below.

8896.name: In The Streets Of Dim Carcosa

north.description: To the north lies Before the Black Building.

8896.description:
This street ends in a half-ruined theatre, its curved tiers of seats
crumbling toward a stage where tatters of yellow cloth still hang from a
fallen frame. The tiers are empty, yet the silence here has the held-
breath feeling of an audience waiting. Masks of stone are carved along
the rim of the stage, all of them pale and all of them smiling. The only
way out is north, back to the square.

8897.name: In The Streets Of Dim Carcosa

south.description: To the south lies Before the Black Building.

8897.description:
The street ends at the edge of the city, where a broken balustrade looks
out over a vast, still lake. Mist lies on the water in long banks that
roll slowly like waves of cloud, and on the far shore the towers of
another city, or of this one, rise into the gloom. The black stars hang
low over the lake. The only way back is south to the square.

8898.name: The Black Building

west.description: To the west lies Before the Black Building.

down.description: To the down lies The Tomb Of The Father Of All Dragons.

8898.description:
Within its black walls the building has no roof, and the dim sky with
its black stars looks down into a vast empty court floored with glassy
black stone. There is no furniture, no carving, no sign of what this
place was for, only an enormous silence. In the centre of the floor a
broad stair goes down into the earth, each step wide enough for a wagon.
The door in the west wall leads back to the square.

8899.name: The Tomb Of The Father Of All Dragons

up.description: To the up lies The Black Building.

8899.description:
The stair ends in a vault so huge that its far walls are lost in
darkness, and the air is warm and smells faintly of brimstone and old
ash. In the centre lies a sarcophagus of black stone the length of a
ship, its lid carved with a coiled dragon whose wings fold over the
whole of it. Scales as wide as shields are set into the walls like
tiles, each one of dull bronze. The only way out is the stair up to the
Black Building.

extra_descs.sarcophagus dragon carving lid:
The carved dragon's eyes are closed, but the lid has been shifted a
hand's breadth from its place, and the stone at the gap is scored with
deep, parallel grooves like the marks of claws.

9500.name: Ocean Pier

north.description: To the north lies In the ocean by the Ocean Pier.

south.description: To the south lies Port Harem.

9500.description:
The Ocean Pier runs a long way out over the water on tarred piles, its
planks bleached grey and warped by the sun. Iron cleats along its edges
are worn bright by mooring ropes, and the boards smell of tar, salt and
fish. North, the pier ends at a landing stage above the open ocean.
South, it meets the shore at Port Harem, where painted lanterns hang
from the eaves.

9501.name: In the Ocean

south.description: To the south lies In the ocean by the Ocean Pier.

9501.description:
The ocean meets a long reef here, marked by a line of breakers that no
boat could hope to cross. Over the reef's edge the water turns a vivid,
milky green. The roar of the surf is constant, and a fine haze of spray
hangs in the air. The only open water lies back south toward the Ocean
Pier.

9502.name: In the ocean by the Ocean Pier

north.description: To the north lies In the Ocean.

east.description: To the east lies In the Ocean.

south.description: To the south lies Ocean Pier.

9502.description:
The Ocean Pier stands on tall piles to the south, its timbers green with
weed below the tide line. A landing stage at its end lets boats come
alongside out of the swell. The water is calm in the pier's lee, clear
enough to see the sandy bottom ribbed by the tide. Open ocean stretches
away north and east.

9503.name: In the Ocean

north.description: To the north lies The Sea Of Storms.

south.description: To the south lies In the Ocean.

west.description: To the west lies In the ocean by the Ocean Pier.

9503.description:
The ocean here is warmer and bluer than the storm sea, and a steady
current carries your boat along. To the north the grey water of the Sea
of Storms heaves under its clouds, while the sky overhead is clearing.
Westward the tarred piles of a long pier stand out of the water. The
current runs on south, smooth and strong.

9504.name: In the Ocean

north.description: To the north lies In the Ocean.

south.description: To the south lies At a bend in the current on the ocean..

9504.description:
The ocean is calm and immense here, its surface creased by a long, lazy
swell. Clumps of yellow weed slide past your boat, all drifting the same
way. Dark clouds still hang along the horizon to the north where the
storm sea lies. The current pulls you on south, toward a place where the
water seems to bend.

9505.name: At a bend in the current on the ocean.

north.description: To the north lies In the Ocean.

east.description: To the east lies At another bend in the current on the ocean.

9505.description:
The current flowing from the north swings through a wide curve here and
runs away east. You can see the bend in the water itself, a long smooth
crease edged with a lace of foam. The sun lies warm on your neck, and
the ocean is empty to every horizon.

9506.name: At another bend in the current on the ocean

south.description: To the south lies At cross-currents in the ocean.

west.description: To the west lies At a bend in the current on the ocean..

9506.description:
The current flowing in from the west turns again here and pours away
south. The water heaps against itself at the turn in a ridge of short,
steep waves. Your boat slews and rocks as it is caught and carried
round. The ocean all around is a deep, dazzling blue beneath a clean
sky.

9507.name: At cross-currents in the ocean

north.description: To the north lies At another bend in the current on the ocean.

east.description: To the east lies In the ocean.

9507.description:
Two currents meet and wrestle here, raising a patch of choppy water that
hisses and slaps against the hull. One stream comes from the north and
the other pulls east, and between them your boat spins uncertainly. Foam
and bubbles boil up through the surface as if the sea were simmering.
Beyond the turmoil the ocean lies calm and blue.

9509.name: In the ocean

south.description: To the south lies At cross-currents in the deep, wide ocean.

west.description: To the west lies At cross-currents in the ocean.

9509.description:
The water runs smooth and deep here, carrying your boat south in a long,
easy glide. The ocean is so clear that sunlight slants into it in
wavering golden shafts that never find a bottom. Back to the west the
cross-currents still churn white. A warm wind blows from somewhere far
off, smelling faintly of flowers and green land.

9510.name: At cross-currents in the deep, wide ocean

north.description: To the north lies In the ocean.

east.description: To the east lies In front of an island port.

west.description: To the west lies At a sharp turn in the current.

9510.description:
The ocean opens out here, vast and deep, and three currents meet in a
great slow whirl of blue water. One runs in from the north, another sets
east toward the masts of an island port, and a third curls away west.
Your boat turns lazily on the swirl like a leaf on a millpond. Beneath
the glittering surface the water looks almost black.

9511.name: At a sharp turn in the current

east.description: To the east lies At cross-currents in the deep, wide ocean.

south.description: To the south lies At a sharp turn in the current.

9511.description:
The current kinks sharply here, bending between east and south around a
broad patch of pale, shallow water. A sandbar glimmers gold through the
clear sea, so near the surface that your oars brush against it. Eastward
the deep ocean turns in its slow great whirl. The sun is hot here, and
the glare off the water makes your eyes ache.

9512.name: At a sharp turn in the current

north.description: To the north lies At a sharp turn in the current.

east.description: To the east lies In front of a pier at an island.

9512.description:
The current turns sharply here, swinging between north and east around a
hidden ledge of rock that shows as a pale shadow beneath the surface.
Water boils over the ledge in a hump of foam, and your boat scrapes past
it with a shudder. East of the turn a rickety pier juts from an island.
The wind here blows steady and cool.

9513.name: In front of a pier at an island

east.description: To the east lies A Cluttered Beach.

south.description: To the south lies At the beginning of a strong east-west current.

west.description: To the west lies At a sharp turn in the current.

9513.description:
To the east a rickety pier runs toward an island beach heaped with
wreckage, broken barrels and bleached spars. Its outer end is blocked by
a barricade of lashed timbers, and the planks behind it have rotted
through in a dozen places. Everything on the island seems oddly still,
as though it were waiting for something. Currents lead away south and
west.

9514.name: At the beginning of a strong east-west current

north.description: To the north lies In front of a pier at an island.

east.description: To the east lies On a strong east-west current.

9514.description:
A powerful current gathers itself here and begins its long run east,
tugging hard at your boat. The water to the north lies calmer, sheltered
by an island whose pier reaches out into the sea. Long streamers of weed
point along the flow like pennants in a wind. It would take strong arms
to row against this stream.

9515.name: On a strong east-west current

north.description: To the north lies Landfall On The Island Of The Dead.

east.description: To the east lies At a cross-currents.

west.description: To the west lies At the beginning of a strong east-west current.

9515.description:
A strong current races from west to east here, hurrying your boat along.
Close by to the north rises a low grey island, its shore lined with dead
trees and leaning stones. Its one landing is shut off by a row of
sharpened stakes driven into the shallows and bound with rusted chain,
and no boat can pass them. The wind off the island smells of cold ash.

extra_descs.stakes chain landing island:
The stakes are black with age and as thick as a man's leg, their points
turned out toward the sea. Whoever drove them in meant to keep something
from landing, or something from leaving.

9516.name: At a cross-currents

north.description: To the north lies At a north-south current in the ocean.

east.description: To the east lies At a cross-currents.

west.description: To the west lies On a strong east-west current.

9516.description:
Currents tangle here in a broad stretch of uneasy water, and the fog
thins enough to show a low grey island off in the murk. A strong stream
sets away west, fast and dark, while gentler currents lead north and
east. The water slaps irritably at the boat, never settling into a
rhythm. Cold drops fall from the fog like slow rain.

9518.name: In front of an island port

north.description: To the north lies At a north-south current in the ocean.

west.description: To the west lies At cross-currents in the deep, wide ocean.

9518.description:
A small island rises from the ocean here, its harbour walls of pale
stone wrapped around a huddle of red roofs and a stubby lighthouse. A
heavy chain boom hangs across the harbour mouth, bearded with green
weed, and there is no gap in it for a boat. Thin smoke rises from a
chimney or two beyond the wall. The current runs north along the
island's shore, and the deep cross-currents lie back to the west.

extra_descs.boom chain harbour:
The boom is a chain of iron links each as long as your forearm, slung
between two squat towers and held up with tarred barrels. From the weed
and rust on it, it has not been lowered in years.

9519.name: At a north-south current in the ocean

north.description: To the north lies At a north-south current in the ocean.

south.description: To the south lies In front of an island port.

9519.description:
A strong current runs north and south here, carrying your boat along the
island's rocky shore. Waves break on black rocks a stone's throw away,
and behind them the slopes rise green with scrub and wind-twisted pines.
The air smells of resin and warm stone. The chained harbour mouth lies
south, and northward the current bears you away from the island.

9520.name: At a north-south current in the ocean

north.description: To the north lies At cross-currents in the ocean.

south.description: To the south lies At a north-south current in the ocean.

9520.description:
The current flows here like a broad river through the ocean, north
toward a patch of troubled water and south toward the island. Lines of
drifting foam mark its edges, and beyond them the sea is almost still.
Your boat runs along between those lines as if on a road. The water is a
deep turquoise, warm when you trail a hand in it.

9521.name: At a north-south current in the ocean

north.description: To the north lies At cross-currents in the ocean.

south.description: To the south lies At a cross-currents.

9521.description:
A cold current runs north and south here, dark as slate and moving fast.
The haze has thickened into a low fog that drifts over the water in
rags. On the cold air comes a faint smell of wet earth and rot. The
water hisses along the hull as the current hurries you on, and your
breath clouds before your face.

9522.name: At cross-currents in the ocean

north.description: To the north lies At a sharp turn in the current.

east.description: To the east lies In the ocean.

south.description: To the south lies At a north-south current in the ocean.

9522.description:
The currents that meet here are cold ones, and the air above their clash
is thick with drifting mist. Waves come at your boat from every quarter,
slapping and sucking at the hull. Through gaps in the mist you glimpse
the dark shape of an island, far off and low. Streams of moving water
lead away north, east and south.

9523.name: At a sharp turn in the current

east.description: To the east lies At a cross-currents.

south.description: To the south lies At cross-currents in the ocean.

9523.description:
The current whips round a sharp corner here, turning between south and
east so suddenly that the water stands in a short, steep wall. Your boat
heels over and spins half round before it rights itself. Weed and foam
are flung out of the turn into the calmer sea beyond. Overhead the
clouds are thickening.

9524.name: At a bend in the current

north.description: To the north lies At cross-currents in the ocean.

east.description: To the east lies In the ocean.

9524.description:
The current curves here from north to east, and on the bend the water
slows into a broad, quiet pool. Rafts of amber weed, studded with tiny
air bladders, collect there and turn in slow circles. The sun is fierce
here, and the air shimmers above the water. Your boat drifts lazily
before the current picks it up again.

9525.name: At a cross-currents

north.description: To the north lies At cross-currents in the ocean.

west.description: To the west lies At a cross-currents.

9525.description:
Here a current from the north runs into another bending west, and the
