west.description: To the west lies The Tapestry Room.

12148.description:
Mounted heads glare from every wall of this room, boar and bear and
stag, and at the end of the row a few that look unpleasantly human.
Glass cases along the walls hold rusted blades and yellowed bones, each
with a neat brass label. Dust lies thick on the glass, though the heads
themselves are oddly clean. A heavy door to the north bears a snarling
stone face, a passage leads east toward a tower, and doorways open south
and west.

12149.name: Dressing Room

north.description: To the north lies Trophy Room.

12149.description:
Rails of costumes crowd this room, black robes and ragged shrouds and
masks of grinning skulls and weeping saints. A long mirror ringed with
dim lamps covers one wall, and the table beneath it is crusted with
white greasepaint and smears of false blood. It seems that some of the
terrors of this house are made by hand. The only door leads north to the
trophy room.

12150.name: Wailing Tower

west.description: To the west lies Trophy Room.

up.description: To the up lies On The staircase.

12150.description:
This is the foot of a tall, hollow tower, and the wind that creeps in
through its cracks sets up a thin, endless wailing that rises and falls
like a voice. A spiral stair of rusted iron climbs up into the darkness
overhead. The stone walls are damp and streaked with orange stains. A
passage leads back west to the trophy room.

12151.name: On The staircase

up.description: To the up lies Strangely Shaped Hallway.

down.description: To the down lies Wailing Tower.

12151.description:
The iron staircase spirals up through the hollow tower, its steps narrow
and slick with damp. Each step rings faintly underfoot, and the wailing
of the wind is louder here, coming from everywhere at once. A rail of
twisted iron is all that keeps you from the drop. Above you the stair
ends at an oddly angled doorway, and below it winds down to the tower's
foot.

12152.name: Cell

north.description: To the north lies Strangely Shaped Hallway.

12152.description:
This tiny cell has no window, only a barred slot in the door to the
north that lets in a little grey light. Mouldy straw is heaped in one
corner beneath an iron ring set into the wall, from which hangs a short
chain. The plaster is covered in scratches, hundreds of them, as though
someone had tried to dig out with bare fingernails. The air smells of
damp and old fear.

12153.name: Strangely Shaped Hallway

north.description: To the north lies Open Hearth.

east.description: To the east lies Supply Room.

south.description: To the south lies Cell.

up.description: To the up lies Creepy Hallway.

down.description: To the down lies On The staircase.

12153.description:
Nothing in this hallway is quite square, for the walls lean inward, the
floor tilts, and the ceiling sags so low at one end that you must stoop.
Doors are set at odd angles to the north, east and south, and no two of
them are the same size. A narrow stair climbs up to the floor above, and
the iron staircase leads down into the tower. Looking along the hallway
for long makes your head swim.

12154.name: Open Hearth

south.description: To the south lies Strangely Shaped Hallway.

12154.description:
A great open hearth fills one wall of this room, wide enough to roast an
ox whole, its stones blackened by years of fires. Embers still glow
among the ashes, and their heat is welcome after the chill of the halls,
though the smoke smells oddly sweet. Iron hooks and chains hang in the
mouth of the chimney. The only door leads back south.

12155.name: Supply Room

west.description: To the west lies Strangely Shaped Hallway.

12155.description:
Shelves climb every wall of this cramped storeroom, crowded with jars,
sacks and stoppered bottles. Some of the jars hold pale shapes floating
in cloudy liquid, and you decide not to look too closely. Hooks on the
beams hold coils of rope, bundles of black candles and lengths of chain.
A smell of tallow and vinegar hangs in the air, and the door leads back
west.

12156.name: Deserted Bedroom

north.description: To the north lies Creepy Hallway.

12156.description:
A four-poster bed stands in the middle of this room, its curtains torn
and its covers flung back as if someone fled in the night. Dust lies
thick over everything, and the mirror of the dressing table has been
smashed into a web of cracks. In one corner a wooden rocking horse
creaks gently to and fro, though nothing has touched it. The door leads
back north.

12157.name: Creepy Hallway

north.description: To the north lies Creepy Hallway.

east.description: To the east lies Office Of The High Priest Of Fear.

south.description: To the south lies Deserted Bedroom.

west.description: To the west lies Creepy Hallway.

down.description: To the down lies Strangely Shaped Hallway.

12157.description:
This hallway crosses the upper floor of the house, its walls papered in
a pattern of dark vines that seem to writhe at the edge of your sight. A
carved door to the east bears a brass plate engraved with the words High
Priest of Fear, and a plainer door opens to the south. Candles gutter in
sconces along the walls, though no draught can be felt. The hall runs on
north and west, and a narrow stair leads down to the crooked hallway
below.

12158.name: Office Of The High Priest Of Fear

west.description: To the west lies Creepy Hallway.

12158.description:
The High Priest of Fear keeps a richly furnished office, with a great
desk of black wood, shelves of leather-bound books and a rug the colour
of old wine. A silver mask twisted into a scream hangs on the wall
behind the desk, catching the lamplight. Heavy incense smoulders in a
bronze bowl, and its sweet, choking smoke clings to everything. The only
way out is the door to the west.

extra_descs.mask silver:
The silver is beaten thin and polished to a mirror, so that your own
face stares back at you through the screaming mouth. Small hooks along
its edge show that it was made to be worn.

12159.name: Creepy Hallway

north.description: To the north lies Closet.

south.description: To the south lies Creepy Hallway.

12159.description:
The hallway ends here at a narrow black door set into the north wall.
Portraits in heavy frames line the walls, and though the faces differ,
every one has the same pale, staring eyes. The paint has darkened and
cracked everywhere but on those eyes, which look wet and freshly done.
The hallway leads back south.

12160.name: Closet

south.description: To the south lies Creepy Hallway.

12160.description:
This closet is barely large enough to turn around in, and it reeks of
camphor with something sourer underneath. Moth-eaten robes of black and
crimson hang from a rail, rustling faintly though the air is still. Long
scratches score the inside of the door, at about the height of a child.
The door opens south onto the hallway.

12161.name: Creepy Hallway

north.description: To the north lies Creepy Hallway.

east.description: To the east lies Creepy Hallway.

12161.description:
The hallway turns a corner here, and the floor seems to slope away from
you whichever way you face. A tall case clock stands against the wall,
ticking loudly, though its hands never move from a quarter to midnight.
The wallpaper here has been torn away in long strips, baring grey
plaster beneath. The hall runs north and east.

12162.name: Creepy Hallway

north.description: To the north lies Creepy Hallway.

south.description: To the south lies Creepy Hallway.

12162.description:
The hallway narrows here between walls draped in black crepe, and the
ceiling is so low that cobwebs brush your hair. Somewhere inside the
walls a faint knocking starts, stops, and starts again. The loose
floorboards groan under your weight. Each candle sconce along the wall
holds only a stub of melted black wax. The hall runs on north and back
south.

12163.name: Creepy Hallway

south.description: To the south lies Creepy Hallway.

west.description: To the west lies Balcony.

12163.description:
A pair of tall glass doors at this end of the hallway open west onto a
balcony, and a breath of fresh air drifts in through them. After the
stale gloom of the house it smells wonderfully of salt and rain. Damp
has blistered the wallpaper around the doors, and a dark stain spreads
over the floorboards. The hall leads back south into the house.

12164.name: Balcony

east.description: To the east lies Creepy Hallway.

12164.description:
This narrow balcony juts from the wall of the Building of Fear high
above the ground, its iron railing rusted and loose. From here you can
see the whole of Vice Hill, the dead hedges of Creepy Road, and beyond
them the grey glitter of the sea. The wind tugs at your clothes, and
rain clouds scud low across the sky. Glass doors lead back east into the
house.

12061.name: Torture Chamber
12061.description:
This is a very small room in which there are many tools designed
specifically for inflicting pain and suffering. Some of them are
familiar, such as the rack and the iron maidens. Others, you have never
seen before and they make you wonder about the kind of sadistic mind
that dreamt them up. The only exit is to the west. The air is still and
musty. The ceiling hangs low overhead.

north.description: To the north lies Square.

south.description: To the south lies Screening Room.

12166.name: Screening Room

north.description: To the north lies Torture Chamber.

south.description: To the south lies Outlay.

12166.description:
An iron lattice divides this bare room in two, so that those on one side
can be looked over from the other like beasts at a fair. A bench bolted
to the floor has been worn smooth by many nervous hands. Behind a heavy,
iron-banded door to the north lies a room that smells of hot metal and
old blood. The outlay lies back south.

12167.name: Outlay

north.description: To the north lies Screening Room.

south.description: To the south lies Square.

12167.description:
Long tables run the length of this narrow room, each place on them
marked with a painted number. The tables are bare now, but pale outlines
in the dust show where boots, belts and purses were once laid out for
counting. A clerk's high desk stands by the door to the north, and the
great square lies back south. A chill hangs in the air, as if the room
remembers every one of them.

12168.name: Outlay

south.description: To the south lies Waiting Room.

12168.description:
Bins of rough planks line the walls of this cramped room, each one
marked with a letter and empty now save for a few rags. A brass scale
for weighing coin stands on a shelf, its pans green with verdigris.
Someone has chalked long columns of figures on the wall, adding up to a
total that has been angrily scrubbed out. The only way out is back
south.

12169.name: Waiting Room

north.description: To the north lies Outlay.

west.description: To the west lies Interrogation Centre.

12169.description:
This waiting room is smaller and colder than it needs to be, its
whitewashed walls bare of any comfort. A row of iron rings runs along
one wall at waist height, a few still trailing short chains. A stone
trough of stale water stands in the corner, skinned with dust. The
interrogation room lies west, and a narrow doorway leads north.

12170.name: Interrogation Centre

east.description: To the east lies Waiting Room.

south.description: To the south lies Dark Room.

12170.description:
A heavy chair with leather straps on its arms and legs is bolted to the
floor here, facing a plain wooden desk. A shuttered lantern on the desk
is angled to shine full in the face of whoever sits in the chair. The
walls are padded with stained canvas to deaden every sound. Doorways
lead east to another waiting room and south into darkness.

12172.name: Waiting Room

west.description: To the west lies Interrogation Centre.

12172.description:
Hard wooden benches line the walls of this cheerless room, and the floor
before them is worn into grooves by restless feet. Names, dates and
short prayers are scratched into every inch of the wood. A lamp on a
chain gives a weak yellow light that makes the wait feel longer. The way
out leads west, toward muffled sounds you would rather not name.

12173.name: Outlay

north.description: To the north lies Waiting Room.

12173.description:
This low room has the look of a storeroom put to darker uses. Pegs along
the walls hold leg irons and lengths of chain, each with a number
chalked above it. A long table in the middle is stained with spilled ink
and darker blotches. The only way on is a doorway to the north.

12175.name: Alcove

west.description: To the west lies Sitting Room.

12175.description:
This narrow alcove is barely wider than a man's outstretched arms,
closed off from the sitting room by a curtain of heavy brown velvet. A
stone shelf runs along the back wall, crusted with the stubs of a
hundred candles burned down to nothing. Above it, scratched into the
plaster by many different hands, are rows of names, some of them crossed
through. The curtain to the west is the only way out.

12176.name: Sitting Room

east.description: To the east lies Alcove.

north.description: To the north lies Outlay.

12176.description:
Someone has tried to make this cellar room comfortable, and the effort
is more unsettling than bare stone would be. Two armchairs with faded
rose covers face a cold hearth, and a tall clock stands against the
wall, its pendulum stopped and its face painted with smiling suns. A
threadbare rug hides most of the flagstones, though not the dark stain
near its edge. The outlay lies through a doorway to the north, and a
curtained alcove opens to the east.

12177.name: Outlay

south.description: To the south lies Sitting Room.

up.description: To the up lies Square.

12177.description:
Long trestle tables fill this low cellar, their tops chalked into
numbered squares where whatever is taken from the prisoners is laid out,
counted and tagged. A ledger is chained to the end of each table, its
pages ruled into columns and filled in a small, patient hand. The smell
of tallow and old leather hangs beneath the vaulted ceiling. Worn stone
steps climb up to the Square, and a narrow doorway to the south opens on
a sitting room.

12178.name: Square

north.description: To the north lies Outlay.

east.description: To the east lies Deserted Corridor.

south.description: To the south lies Entrance To The Hall Of Hopelessness.

up.description: To the up lies Outlay.

down.description: To the down lies Outlay.

12178.description:
This great square chamber lies beneath a vaulted stone roof, so large
that the light of its few lamps never reaches the corners. A dry
fountain stands at its heart, the basin heaped with grey ash. Wooden
stairs climb up to a gallery, a stone stair leads down into the depths,
and doorways open north, east and south. Every sound you make comes back
to you a moment late.

12179.name: Entrance To The Hall Of Hopelessness

north.description: To the north lies Square.

east.description: To the east lies Deserted Corridor.

south.description: To the south lies Tarry Tunnel.

12179.description:
A tall arch of black stone marks the entrance to the Hall of
Hopelessness, and words are carved deep into its keystone. Beneath the
arch a tunnel sealed with tar runs away south into darkness, breathing
out a cold draught that smells of pitch and damp. The great square lies
north, and a deserted corridor leads east. The flagstones beneath the
arch are worn into hollows by dragging feet.

extra_descs.keystone words arch inscription:
The carved words read: Leave Hope With Those Who Wait For You. Beneath
them someone has scratched a row of tally marks that stops in the middle
of a group.

12180.name: Deserted Corridor

north.description: To the north lies Deserted Corridor.

east.description: To the east lies Dark Room.

west.description: To the west lies Tarry Road.

12180.description:
This bare corridor is lined with tarred planks that sweat sticky beads
of pitch. Dust and dead leaves have blown in through the doorway to the
west, where grey daylight shows. Another doorway to the east opens onto
blackness so thick it seems solid, and the corridor runs on north. Your
footsteps echo as if the place were empty for miles.

12181.name: Deserted Corridor

north.description: To the north lies Deserted Corridor.

east.description: To the east lies Dark Room.

south.description: To the south lies Deserted Corridor.

west.description: To the west lies Entrance To The Hall Of Hopelessness.

12181.description:
Here the corridor is crossed by a wider passage, and the tarred planks
give way to rough stone. To the west a tall archway leads toward the
Hall of Hopelessness, and to the east another doorway opens into
darkness. An iron bracket on the wall holds the charred stump of a torch
that burned out long ago. The corridor runs on north and south.

12182.name: Deserted Corridor

south.description: To the south lies Deserted Corridor.

west.description: To the west lies Square.

12182.description:
The corridor comes to an end against a blank stone wall, and a broad
opening to the west leads into a great square chamber. Rows of old
notices are nailed beside the opening, their ink faded beyond reading.
Grit crunches underfoot, and the air is stale and dry. The corridor runs
back south.

12183.name: Dark Room

north.description: To the north lies Interrogation Centre.

west.description: To the west lies Deserted Corridor.

12183.description:
No lamp has ever been hung in this room, and the blackness is so thick
that it seems to press against your eyes. Your hands find walls of
rough, damp stone, and grit crunches underfoot at every step. Somewhere
close a slow drip counts out the seconds. A thin line of light shows
beneath a door to the north, where the Interrogation Centre lies, and
the deserted corridor opens back to the west.

12184.name: Through The Trees

north.description: To the north lies Through The Trees.

down.description: To the down lies Vice Hill.

12184.description:
A steep path scrambles up from Vice Hill into a wood of tall, wind-bent
pines, their roots gripping the slope like knuckled fingers. The noise
and smoke of the hill fade quickly, replaced by the creak of branches
and the sigh of wind in the needles. Steps cut into the earth and edged
with split logs lead down to the hillside below. Northward the path
levels out and wanders on among the trunks.

12185.name: Through The Trees

north.description: To the north lies Through The Trees.

south.description: To the south lies Through The Trees.

12185.description:
The pines grow close together here, and the light beneath them is a dim,
rust-coloured gloom. A thick carpet of needles swallows the sound of
your steps. Someone has blazed the trunks along the path with a hatchet,
each cut daubed with red paint so that it can be followed by lantern
light. The marks lead north into the wood and south toward the steps
above Vice Hill.

12186.name: Through The Trees

north.description: To the north lies Through The Trees.

south.description: To the south lies Through The Trees.

12186.description:
A great pine has come down across the path, and rather than clear it,
someone has sawn a gap through the trunk just wide enough for a man with
a load on his back. The earth in the gap is churned and grooved, as if
heavy sledges are hauled through it often. Ferns crowd the hollow left
by the torn-up roots, and the resin of the cut wood still scents the
air. Beyond the fallen trunk the path goes on north, and it runs back
south between the pines.

12187.name: Through The Trees

north.description: To the north lies Through The Trees.

south.description: To the south lies Through The Trees.

12187.description:
A small stream crosses the path here in a stony bed, and two flat stones
have been set in the water as a crossing. The pines thin a little around
it, letting in a slanting light that turns the water amber. Moss grows
thick on the boulders along the banks, and the air is cool and smells of
wet earth. From somewhere ahead comes the faint, steady hush of surf.
Over the stepping stones the path heads north, and it climbs back south
into the trees.

12188.name: Through The Trees

north.description: To the north lies Through The Trees.

south.description: To the south lies Through The Trees.

12188.description:
The wood changes here, the pines giving way to twisted holm oaks whose
dark, leathery leaves rattle in the wind off the sea. Sand has begun to
creep in among the leaf litter, pale and gritty underfoot. A tree beside
the path has been hollowed by fire, and its blackened heart is just big
enough to hide a man or a barrel. The path leads north toward the sound
of the waves and south deeper into the pines.

12189.name: Through The Trees

north.description: To the north lies Port By The Forest.

south.description: To the south lies Through The Trees.

12189.description:
The trees here lean away from the wind, and between their trunks you
catch glimpses of grey water and white breakers. The smell of salt and
weed grows strong, and the ground is more sand than soil, held together
by tufts of spiky grass. A rope strung from trunk to trunk along the
path serves as a handrail, rubbed smooth by many palms. The path drops
north toward Port By The Forest and rises back south into the wood.

12190.name: Port By The Forest

south.description: To the south lies Through The Trees.

12190.description:
The trees come right down to the water in this sheltered cove, so close
that their roots trail in the tide. A jetty of rough grey planks runs
out from the shore on pilings green with weed, and a lantern post at its
end is hooded so that its light would show only to the sea. A boathouse
of logs stands under the pines with its doors chained shut. The only way
out is the path that leads back south through the trees.

extra_descs.lantern post hood:
The lantern is fitted with a hinged iron hood worked by a chain, so that
whoever holds the chain can show a light to the sea and hide it from the
land in the same moment. The glass is clean and the wick freshly
trimmed.

12191.name: Hall Of Wax

north.description: To the north lies Hall Of Death.

east.description: To the east lies Office Of The High Priest Of Terror.

12191.description:
Figures of wax stand in rows along this long hall, each on its own
plinth, each a man or woman caught in a moment of terror so lifelike
that you half expect to hear them scream. Their glass eyes follow the
flicker of the candles set at their feet. The air is warm and thick with
the smell of tallow and something sweeter beneath it. A door to the
north leads to the Hall Of Death, and the high priest's office lies
through an arch to the east.

extra_descs.figures wax plinths:
Each plinth bears a small brass plate engraved with a name and a date.
The faces are made with horrible care, down to the pores of the skin and
the tears on the cheeks, and some of the hair looks very much like real
hair.

12192.name: Entrance To The Office Of The High Priest Of Terror

north.description: To the north lies Entrance To The Temple Of Terror.

south.description: To the south lies Office Of The High Priest Of Terror.

west.description: To the west lies Hall Of Death.

12192.description:
This antechamber is panelled in dark wood carved with writhing figures,
and a long bench runs along one wall for those summoned to wait upon the
high priest. A brass plate on the south door bears his title, polished
bright by his attendants. The air smells of ink, sealing wax and the
incense that drifts in from the temple through the door to the north. A
black curtain to the west hides the way into the Hall Of Death.

12193.name: Hall Of Torture

east.description: To the east lies Entrance To The Office Of The High Priest Of Terror.

south.description: To the south lies Hall Of Death.

12193.description:
Here the temple keeps its instruments on display as proudly as a
guildhall keeps its silver: the rack, the wheel, the scold's bridle and
a dozen stranger devices, each on its own stand with a brass plaque
beneath. Everything is oiled, polished and in good repair. Chains hang
from rings in the vaulted ceiling, and the floor slopes gently toward a
drain at the centre. A doorway to the east leads to the high priest's
antechamber, and the Hall Of Death lies south.

12194.name: Hall Of Death

north.description: To the north lies Hall Of Torture.

east.description: To the east lies Entrance To The Office Of The High Priest Of Terror.

south.description: To the south lies Hall Of Wax.

12194.description:
Stone biers stand in two rows down this cold hall, each covered by a
grey sheet that sinks into the hollows of the shape beneath. A deep
channel cut in the floor runs between them to a grated drain, stained
dark along its length. Bunches of dried herbs hang from the beams,
failing to mask the smell. The Hall Of Torture opens to the north, a
door leads south to the Hall Of Wax, and an archway east returns to the
high priest's antechamber.

12195.name: Office Of The High Priest Of Terror

north.description: To the north lies Entrance To The Office Of The High Priest Of Terror.

west.description: To the west lies Hall Of Wax.

12195.description:
The high priest's office is a room of unsettling neatness: a broad desk
of black wood bare but for an inkstand, shelves of ledgers bound in grey
leather, and a tall chair whose carved back curves over like a hood.
Behind the desk hangs a map of Port Halyon, its streets studded with
little red pins, one for each house the temple watches. A smell of warm
tallow comes through an archway to the west, where the Hall Of Wax lies.
The antechamber is back to the north.

12197.name: Entrance To The Temple Of Terror

north.description: To the north lies Trail of Terror.

east.description: To the east lies Blindingly Lit Hallway.

south.description: To the south lies Entrance To The Office Of The High Priest Of Terror.

12197.description:
Beyond the iron door the temple swallows the daylight in a narthex of
black marble, its walls polished so smooth that your own shape moves
dimly in them. Censers hang on chains from the ceiling and breathe out a
heavy, honeyed smoke that stings the throat. To the east a hard white
light pours from the mouth of a hallway, too bright to look into. A
passage leads south toward the high priest's office, and the door to the
trail stands north.

12198.name: Blindingly Lit Hallway

north.description: To the north lies Shrine To Vice.

east.description: To the east lies Blindingly Lit Hallway.

west.description: To the west lies Entrance To The Temple Of Terror.

12198.description:
Light floods this hallway from every side, from hundreds of oil lamps
set before polished brass mirrors that line the walls from floor to
ceiling. The glare is so fierce that you must squint through your
fingers, and the mirrors swim in a white haze. The heat of the flames is
stifling. Through the glare you can make out an arch to the north
leading to a shrine, while the hall runs on east and back west to the
temple entrance.

12199.name: Shrine To Vice

south.description: To the south lies Blindingly Lit Hallway.

12199.description:
After the glare of the hallway, this small shrine is lit only by a ruby
lamp, and its red dusk is a relief to the eyes. On a dais of veined
marble sits a fat, smiling idol of gilded wood with six arms, each of
them holding out some token of appetite. The floor before it is worn
into two smooth hollows by the knees of worshippers. The only way out is
south into the light.

extra_descs.idol statue arms:
The idol's six hands hold a wine cup, a pair of dice, a fat purse, a
sweetmeat, a key and a mask. Its gilt has been rubbed from its belly by
the palms of those who touch it for luck, leaving the bare wood dark and
greasy.

12200.name: Blindingly Lit Hallway

north.description: To the north lies Grand Temple Of Terror.

east.description: To the east lies Blindingly Lit Hallway.

west.description: To the west lies Blindingly Lit Hallway.

12200.description:
Here the light pours from a great chandelier of crystal prisms, ablaze
with candles and scattering hard white sparks across every surface. The
floor is tiled in white enamel that throws the glare back into your face
until walls and floor blur into one blaze. Ropes of black velvet hang
along the walls for the blinded to follow. Double doors to the north
open into the Grand Temple Of Terror, and the hallway continues east and
west.

12202.name: Blindingly Lit Hallway

west.description: To the west lies Blindingly Lit Hallway.

12202.description:
The hallway ends in a blank wall of polished silver, curved like the
inside of a bowl, that gathers the light of a ring of lamps and hurls it
back down the passage in a single blinding beam. Standing here is like
standing inside the sun; your shadow vanishes and your eyes run with
tears. The stone underfoot is warm to the touch. The blazing hall leads
back west, the only way out.

12204.name: Grand Temple Of Terror

east.description: To the east lies Entrance To The Temple Of Terror.

south.description: To the south lies Blindingly Lit Hallway.

12204.description:
The nave of the Grand Temple rises into a darkness that the light of its
braziers cannot reach, and the sense of something vast watching from
that darkness is hard to shake. Rows of black pews face an altar of
rough basalt, and behind it hangs an enormous mask of beaten silver, its
mouth stretched wide in a frozen shriek. The air is thick with incense
and the smell of hot iron. A door to the east leads back to the temple
entrance, and the bright hallway lies south.

extra_descs.mask silver:
The mask is taller than three men, hammered from sheets of silver
riveted together. Its hollow eyes are set with black glass, and when the
braziers flare a low moan seems to sound from somewhere within its open
mouth.

15100.name: Dock On The Island Of Morvoct

north.description: To the north lies The Southern Sea Of Storms.

south.description: To the south lies Gate To Kyor'Glt.

15100.description:
A dock of massive stone blocks lies at the mouth of the sea tunnel,
where the water calms into a clear pool walled by cliffs and open to a
sky of racing cloud. Grass grows thick between the blocks, and the iron
mooring rings are rusted almost through, for few boats tie up here.
Beyond the dock a slope of turf and sea thrift rises toward a wall of
dark stone and its gate. The tunnel leads back north to the open sea,
and a paved way climbs south to the gate.

15101.name: Gate To Kyor'Glt

north.description: To the north lies Dock On The Island Of Morvoct.

south.description: To the south lies The Untravelled Path.

15101.description:
A wall of green-black stone runs across the island here, and in it
stands the Gate To Kyor'Glt, two leaves of bronze gone blue with age and
carved with faces that have the round, lidless eyes of fish. The gates
are shut and barred from the far side, and thorny sea-buckthorn has
grown up thick against them. Through a crack between the leaves an
untravelled path can just be seen, lost under weeds. The only open way
leads north, back to the dock.

extra_descs.faces carvings gate bronze:
The fish-eyed faces wear crowns of shells and coral, and between them
runs a line of writing in no script you know. The bronze is pitted by
salt, but the carving is still sharp, as if its makers meant it to
outlast them.

15188.name: The Southern Sea Of Storms

north.description: To the north lies The Sea Of Storms.

south.description: To the south lies Dock On The Island Of Morvoct.

15188.description:
Here the Southern Sea Of Storms pours into a long tunnel of black rock
that runs right through the cliffs of Morvoct, and a ledge cut along one
wall gives a footing above the surging water. The roof arches high
overhead, hung with dripping weed, and every wave that rolls in from the
north fills the tunnel with booming echoes. Green daylight glimmers at
the far end to the south, where the dock lies. The rock is slick and
cold, and the air tastes of salt.

12000.name: judge
12000.long_desc: An adjudicator is watching the games intently.
12000.description:
The adjudicator is a retired gladiator and scars cover all exposed parts of
his body.  Although he is getting on in years, he remains healthy and fit.

12001.name: scorekeeper
12001.long_desc: A scorekeeper has one eye on his stopwatch and the other on a clipboard.
12001.description:
The scorekeeper is a young man of about 25 years of age and is very intently
studying his clipboard.

12003.name: spectator
12003.long_desc: A spectator is here watching the games.
12003.description: The spectator is filthy, half drunk and screaming his head off.

12004.name: noble
12004.long_desc: A nobleman stands here looking aloof.
12004.description:
The nobleman is dressed in fine clothes and jewelry and has a very snobbish
attitude.  While he is getting old and his hair and beard are streaked with
gray, he is by no means an easy target.

12005.name: slave
12005.long_desc: A slave stands here, wishing that she was free.
12005.description:
A very pretty young woman who was captured instead of being killed when
the Roman legions subjugated her land.

12006.name: gladiator
12006.long_desc: There is a gladiator standing here.
12006.description:
A well muscled man who is very heavily armored and armed to the teeth.  He
lives for combat.

12007.name: driver
12007.long_desc: There is a chariot driver here.
12007.description:
You see a very slight and small individual whose whole life is centered around
nothing but horses and speed.

12008.name: coach
12008.long_desc: There is a coach standing here, going over last minute strategy.
12008.description:
As you try to look over his shoulder and listen in on his mumbling,
he looks up at you and gives you a glare that chills you to the
bone.

12009.name: healer
12009.description:
You see a young man, still learning about magical healing, wearing a white 
coat and using a stethoscope.

12010.name: herbalist
12010.long_desc: There is a beautiful young lady here, standing here.
12010.description:
The herbalist is a very beautiful young lady who is about 22 years old.  She 
has deep brown eyes and shoulder-length chestnut hair.  Her body is perfectly 
proportioned and she stands about 5' 5" tall.

12011.name: shopkeeper
12011.long_desc: Titus' shopkeeper is here, minding the store.
12011.description:
The shopkeeper is an older man in his middle to late fifties and looks like
he enjoys the quiet life.  There is a long scar running from the edge of his
mouth to his right ear, making it look like he is always smiling.

12012.name: peddler
12012.long_desc: A poor peddler is standing here, trying to support his meager existence.
12012.description: You see a small, dirty man who doesn't look very healthy.

12013.name: page
12013.long_desc: A page stands here, waiting to run an errand.
12013.description:
You see a young boy who looks very strong and very fast.  He has the look of
a scholar about him.

12014.name: plaintiff
12014.long_desc: The plaintiff stands here, pleading his case.

12015.name: master
12015.long_desc: A ticket master is here, looking at you expectantly.
12015.description:
He seems to be waiting for you to either buy a ticket or to get out
of his way so that he can sell tickets to people that actually want
them.

12016.name: vendor
12016.long_desc: A stadium vendor is walking here, selling overpriced hotdogs and beer.
12016.description:
The vendor is a scruffy looking man who isn't afraid of a fight and looks
like he has had just about enough of smart-mouthed spectators.

12017.name: citizen
12017.long_desc: A citizen of Rome is standing here.
12017.description: It appears to be your ordinary citizen going about his business.

12018.name: gateguard
12018.long_desc: A gateguard stands here, tending the gate.
12018.description: You see a strong, loyal public defender.

12019.name: soldier
12019.long_desc: A soldier on leave is walking around looking for entertainment.
12019.description:
You see a member of one of the Emperor's elite legions.  He looks VERY strong.
You have this vague feeling that his entertainment isn't going to be a very
wholesome activity.

12020.name: emperor
12020.long_desc: Julius Caesar, the Emperor of Rome, is sitting here.
12020.description:
You see a man who is dressed in the finest of clothes, has eaten the best of
foods and lived in the most opulent palace that Rome has ever known.

12021.name: guard
12021.long_desc: There is a royal bodyguard here, ready to die for the Emperor, if necessary.
12021.description:
The bodyguard is dressed in the finest of armor and wields only the
deadliest of weapons.  He is very strong and would put up one hell
of a fight.  He has been trained to be suspicious of all but the
most innocent visitors, and likely to take offense of anyone with
less than pure intentions.

12022.name: judge
12022.long_desc: A judge is standing here, reading a case.
12022.description:
He seems to be quite interested in the case, perhaps you shouldn't
disturb him now, later would probably be a better time.

12023.name: master
12023.long_desc: The master scheduler is here, writing in an appointment book.
12023.description:
As you look at him, he looks up at you and asks, 'Do you have an
appointment?'  He waits for a few seconds and then asks, 'Would
you like one?'

12024.name: slimeball
12024.long_desc: A green ball of slime is hanging over you, oozing downward.
12024.description: There is a green 'ball' of slime oozing from the coating on the walls.

12025.name: froboz
12025.long_desc: Froboz the wizard is standing here, working on a new spell.
12025.description:
You see a middle-aged man whose knowledge of magic, both offensive and 
defensive, is legendary.  He literally glows with a pink aura.

12026.name: titus
12026.long_desc: Titus Andronicus is standing here, polishing a few swords.
12026.description:
As you look at him, he suddenly swings a newly sharpened sword
at you!  Watch out!

12027.name: senator
12027.long_desc: A senator is here, waiting for debate to begin.
12027.description: He seems to be quite bored and is playing with the edge of his toga.

12028.name: bailiff
12028.long_desc: The bailiff stands here, keeping order in the courtroom.
12028.description:
He is a very stern man and insists on absolute quiet in his courtroom
unless the judge has given someone permisson to speak.

12029.name: defendant
12029.long_desc: The defendant stands here, pleading her case.
12029.description: She looks to be well organized and full of confidence.

12030.name: jupiter
12030.long_desc: Jupiter, King of the Gods, is watching over his realm here.
12030.description:
He is the strongest of the Gods, and certainly no easy mark!  His powers
transcend the plane of the physical, and could easily kill an unprepared
mortal.

12031.name: venus
12031.long_desc: Venus, the Goddess of Beauty and Knowledge, is resting here.
12031.description:
Venus is probably one of the most beautiful women you have ever seen
if not THE most beautiful.  She is very powerful and tough under that
outer image of beauty.

12032.name: mars
12032.long_desc: Mars, the God of War and State, is sitting down here.
12032.description:
Mars is a tall God with burning, hateful eyes and a large scowl on
his face.

12033.name: mercury
12033.long_desc: Mercury, the messenger of the Gods, is standing here.
12033.description: Mercury is a handsome, youthful God and wears a large grin on his face.

12034.name: shopkeeper
12034.long_desc: Froboz' shopkeeper is here, minding the store.
12034.description:
The shopkeeper is an older man in his middle to late fifties and looks like
he enjoys the quiet life.  There is a long scar running from the edge of his
mouth to his right ear, making it look like he is always smiling.

12035.name: executioner
12035.long_desc: The executioner stands here, waiting to torture some sorry soul.
12035.description:
You see a burly man who is wearing a black hood that obscures his face.  He
has a very sadistic attitude and clearly loves his work.

12036.name: baker
12036.long_desc: The baker looks at you calmly, wiping flour from his face with one hand.
12036.description:
A fat, nice looking baker.  But you can see that he has many scars on his
body.

12037.name: grocer
12037.long_desc: A grocer stands at the counter, with a slightly impatient look on his face.
12037.description: A tall grocer, who moves two 200 pounds bag of flour around on his shoulders.

612000.name: gull harbour grey bird
612000.long_desc: A grey harbour gull struts along the planks, eyeing you for scraps.
612000.description:
A big, heavy-bodied gull with a yellow bill hooked at the tip and a spot
of red near its end. Its pale eyes are cold and calculating, and its
feathers smell of fish and tar. It shows no fear of you at all.

612001.name: crab shore green
612001.long_desc: A green shore crab scuttles sideways over the sand, claws raised.
612001.description:
A broad-backed crab the size of a dinner plate, its shell mottled green
and brown like weedy rock. It holds its claws up and open, ready to
pinch anything that comes too close, and its stalked eyes swivel to
follow you.

612002.name: snake sea banded
612002.long_desc: A banded sea snake ripples through the water, its flat tail sculling.
612002.description:
A slender snake ringed in black and pale blue, with a tail flattened
like an oar blade. It swims with lazy grace, but its small head is
quick, and its bite carries a numbing venom.

612003.name: shark blue
612003.long_desc: A blue shark circles just below the surface, its fin slicing the swell.
612003.description:
A long, slender shark with a deep blue back and a white belly, its snout
pointed and its eyes flat and black. It moves without seeming effort,
and the teeth in its half-open jaws are serrated like saws.

612004.name: shark hammerhead great
612004.long_desc: A great hammerhead shark sweeps past, swinging its broad head from side to side.
612004.description:
Its head is drawn out into a flat bar with an eye at either end, and it
swings it to and fro as it hunts. It is longer than a rowing boat, grey-
brown above and pale beneath, and its flanks are scored with old scars.

612005.name: serpent sea great
612005.long_desc: A great sea serpent rears from the waves, water streaming from its scaly coils.
612005.description:
Coil after coil of green-black scales rolls through the sea, each loop
as thick as a barrel, while a long head crested with ragged fins sways
high above the water. Its eyes are the yellow of old lamplight, and its
breath stinks of the deep.

612006.name: raider desert veiled bandit
612006.long_desc: A veiled desert raider watches you with narrowed eyes, a curved blade in his fist.
612006.description:
He is wrapped from head to foot in sand-coloured cloth, with only a slit
for his dark, narrowed eyes. A curved blade hangs at his hip, and stolen
rings and amulets clink on a cord at his belt. The hidden chambers under
the sand are his band's bolt-hole.

612007.name: smuggler tar sailor man
612007.long_desc: A tar-stained smuggler lurks in the shadows, a knife held low and ready.
612007.description:
His hands and forearms are black with pitch to the elbow, and his
clothes are stiff with it. He has a sailor's rolling gait and a sailor's
squint, and he watches you the way a man watches a fat purse.

612008.name: cultist terror hooded
612008.long_desc: A hooded cultist of terror glides through the gloom, murmuring a litany of dread.
612008.description:
Beneath the black hood is a face painted chalk-white, with dark smudges
around the eyes to make them seem hollow. The robe is stitched with
screaming mouths in red thread, and a long knife hangs from a cord at
the waist.

612009.name: effigy wax figure statue
612009.long_desc: A wax effigy stands stiffly among the shadows, its glass eyes catching the light.
612009.description:
From a few paces away it could pass for a living man, but up close the
skin is waxen and faintly shiny, and the painted lips never move. Here
and there the wax has sagged and run, and something dark and hollow
shows beneath it.

612010.name: shade ghost hollow-eyed
612010.long_desc: A hollow-eyed shade drifts here, its mouth shaping words that never come.
612010.description:
It is the grey, wavering outline of a man in rags, with shackles on its
wrists that make no sound. Its eyes are empty pits, and when it turns
them on you a terrible weariness drags at your limbs. One fist stays
clenched around something it will not let go, as if it has been waiting
a very long time to pay its way out.

612011.name: smuggler sailor man
612011.long_desc: A weather-beaten smuggler watches the path, one hand resting on the knife at his belt.
612011.description:
A lean, sun-blackened man in a tarred coat and grey sharkskin boots, his
hair tied back with a strip of sailcloth. A coil of rope hangs over one
shoulder and a shuttered lantern swings at his hip, and his eyes keep
straying toward the sea. He has the look of someone who would much
rather you had not seen him at all.

612012.name: shark hammerhead fish
612012.long_desc: A hammerhead shark cruises just beneath the surface, its tall fin slicing through the swell.
612012.description:
A long, grey-backed shark with a pale belly and a head flattened into a
broad blade, an unblinking eye set at each end of it. Old scars criss-
cross its hide, and when it turns you glimpse rows of small, serrated
teeth in its crescent of a mouth. It swings its strange head from side
to side as it swims, as if tasting the water for blood.

612013.name: serpent sea scaled
612013.long_desc: A great sea serpent rears out of the water, its coils looping through the waves like the keels of overturned boats.
612013.description:
The serpent is longer than any ship in Port Halyon, its body as thick as
a barrel and armoured in overlapping scales of green-black that shimmer
with oily rainbows. Its head is long and narrow like a pike's, crowned
with a frill of spines, and its eyes glow the same cold, pale green as
the stones of the drowned gate. Barnacles crust the oldest of its
scales.

612014.name: cultist terror robed masked
612014.long_desc: A cultist of terror stands here in black robes, a screaming mask hiding its face.
612014.description:
A figure in heavy robes of black wool, belted with a cord of knotted red
silk, its face hidden behind a mask of white lacquer carved into an
endless scream. Through the eyeholes you glimpse eyes that are perfectly
calm. Its pale hands are flecked with candle wax, and a curved knife
hangs from the cord at its waist.

612015.name: effigy wax figure
612015.long_desc: A wax effigy of a screaming man lurches stiffly forward, its glass eyes rolling.
612015.description:
From a distance it might be one of the figures from the Hall of Wax, and
up close it is: a life-size man moulded in yellowish wax, every pore and
eyelash in place, its mouth stretched in a silent scream. Something has
woken it. It moves in jerky, uncertain steps, leaving soft smears of wax
on whatever it touches, and its glass eyes roll to follow you.

612016.name: shade carcosan shadow
612016.long_desc: A shade of Carcosa drifts silently through the dim air, trailing tatters of darkness.
612016.description:
It has the shape of a tall figure robed in grey, but the shape is thin
and wavering, like a reflection in dark water, and you can see the
stones of the city through it. Where its face should be there is only a
smooth pale oval, like a mask without features. It makes no sound at
all, and the air around it is cold enough to numb your fingers.

12000.name: ring
12000.room_desc: There is a pewter ring lying here.

12001.name: belt
12001.room_desc: There is a bronze belt on the ground here.

12002.name: helmet
12002.room_desc: A Roman combat helmet has been left here.

12003.name: whistle
12003.room_desc: A coach's whistle has been left here.

12004.name: stethoscope
12004.room_desc: There is an odd object laying on the ground here.

12005.name: hairpin
12005.room_desc: A woman's hairpin is lying here.

12006.name: apple
12006.room_desc: A delicious looking apple has been left here.

12007.name: orange
12007.room_desc: A sun-ripened orange has been left here.

12008.name: sandals
12008.room_desc: A pair of leather sandals has been dropped here.

12010.name: hotdog
12010.room_desc: A hotdog loaded with chili and onions has been left here.

12011.name: bracelet
12011.room_desc: A bracelet, made from silver and gold, has been carelessly left here.

12012.name: ring
12012.room_desc: A sapphire ring has been left here.

12013.name: pendant
12013.room_desc: A beautiful jade pendant has been left here.

12014.name: robe
12014.room_desc: Froboz' robe has been dropped here.

12015.name: sword
12015.room_desc: A nasty looking tempered sword is lying here.

12016.name: sword
12016.room_desc: A very bloody, but quenched, sword has been left here.

12017.name: bracers
12017.room_desc: A pair of Moorish bracers has been dropped here.

12018.name: plate
12018.room_desc: A piece of military combat plate has been left here.

12019.name: boots
12019.short_desc: a pair of Roman combat boots
12019.room_desc: A pair of combat boots have been left here.

12020.name: thunderbolt
12020.room_desc: Jupiter's Thunderbolt has been left here.

12021.name: loincloth
12021.room_desc: Mars' red loincloth is resting here.

12022.name: necklace
12022.room_desc: Someone has left the crystal necklace of knowledge here.

12023.name: sandals
12023.room_desc: Mercury's winged sandals have been left here.

12024.name: scroll
12024.room_desc: A scroll has been carelessly left here.

12025.name: scroll
12025.room_desc: An ornate scroll has been left here.

12026.name: scroll
12026.room_desc: A plain scroll is lying on the ground.

12027.name: bag
12027.room_desc: There is a small, sweet-smelling bag here on the ground.

12028.name: staff
12028.room_desc: A Kodarta staff has been carelessly left here.

12029.name: wand
12029.room_desc: There is a prototype of a new magical wand lying here.

12030.name: flask
12030.room_desc: There is a flask, containing a blaze orange potion, resting here.

12031.name: mace
12031.room_desc: An executioner's mace is lying here.

12032.name: mug
12032.room_desc: A frosty mug has been left on the ground here.

12033.name: key
12033.room_desc: There is a rusted key here.

12034.name: key
12034.room_desc: A double sided key has been left here.

12035.name: key
12035.room_desc: A diamond studded key is sitting on the ground.

12036.name: key
12036.short_desc: a key with a pearl handle
12036.room_desc: A key with a pearl handle is sitting on the ground.

12037.name: key
12037.room_desc: There is an aquamarine colored key here.

12038.name: key
12038.room_desc: An opal key has been left here.

12039.name: key
12039.room_desc: A steel key is lying on the ground.

712000.name: knife sailor's sailors rigging
712000.room_desc: A sailor's rigging knife lies here, its grip bound in tarred twine.
712000.description: A short knife with a narrow, wickedly pointed blade, made for working rope and splicing lines but just as handy in a brawl. Its wooden grip is bound in tarred twine that will not slip in a wet hand.

712001.name: boots sharkskin grey
712001.room_desc: A pair of grey sharkskin boots stands here, stiff with salt.
712001.description: These boots are cut from rough grey sharkskin that rasps like a file against your palm. They are stitched with gut and sealed at the seams with pitch, and they keep out the wet better than any leather.

712002.name: mask terror cultist's white
712002.room_desc: A white mask frozen in a scream lies here, staring at nothing.
712002.description: A mask of stiffened white leather shaped into a face caught in mid-scream, its eyeholes ringed with black paint. Behind it you feel the faint, cold thrill of being the thing that others fear.

712003.name: coin carcosan tarnished
712003.room_desc: A tarnished coin of strange design glints dully here.
712003.description: A heavy coin of dark, unfamiliar metal, struck with a crowned figure whose face has worn away and with letters no living scholar can read. Such coins are said to come from drowned Carcosa, and the dead were once laid to rest with one to pay their passage. It stays cold no matter how long you hold it.

712004.name: flask water nomad's goatskin
712004.room_desc: A goatskin water flask stitched with blue thread lies here.
712004.description: A flask of goatskin sealed with resin and stitched with blue desert patterns, slung from a plaited cord. The water inside stays cool long after the sun should have warmed it, and a long swallow puts the strength back into tired limbs.

712005.name: knife sailor's sailors blade
712005.room_desc: A sailor's knife with a tarred grip lies here.
712005.description: A straight, broad-backed knife with a keen point and a grip bound in tarred cord, made for cutting rope and gutting fish. A hole bored through the pommel holds a lanyard, so that it cannot be lost overboard.

712006.name: boots sharkskin pair grey
712006.room_desc: A pair of grey sharkskin boots lies here.
712006.description: Knee-high boots of grey sharkskin, rough as a file against the grain and smooth as silk with it, stitched with waxed gut. The rough soles grip a wet deck or a slick rock as surely as bare feet.

712007.name: mask terror lacquer cultist's
712007.room_desc: A white lacquered mask, carved into a scream, stares up from the ground.
712007.description: A mask of white-lacquered wood carved into a face of utter terror, its mouth wide and its brows drawn up in anguish. The inside is lined with black felt and smells of incense and sweat. Behind it your own face feels very far away.

712008.name: shield scale serpent great
712008.room_desc: A great green-black scale, curved like a shield, lies here.
712008.description: A single scale from a sea serpent's flank, as broad as a man's chest and curved like a buckler. Its thick, horny root makes a natural grip, and its surface shimmers green and black with oily rainbows that blades skid across as off wet stone.

712009.name: coin carcosan gold heavy
712009.room_desc: A heavy coin of greenish gold lies here, catching no light.
712009.description: A thick coin of dull, greenish gold, heavier than it ought to be, stamped on one face with a tall tower beneath a sky of black stars. The other face, where a king's head would be, is blank and smooth. It is cold to the touch and stays cold however long you hold it.
